feature:feature:grim-harbinger-spells.description: Always prepared at Ranger levels: 3 Bane; 5 Hold Person; 9 Fear; 13 Intrusive Despair; 17 Dream.

feature:feature:omen-of-doom.description: Wis mod times (min 1) per Short or Long Rest (or spend a slot), as a Bonus Action doom a creature within 90 feet for 1 hour: once per turn your hits on it add 1d6 Necrotic. A Grim appears within 30 feet of it (AC 13 + Wis mod, HP 5 + 5 x Ranger level, Incorporeal Movement, adds PB to checks and saves; Ominous Rend uses your spell attack for 1d6 + 3 + Wis mod Necrotic and Frightens; Baleful Howl reaction stops a fleeing creature). It Dodges unless commanded with a Bonus Action or by giving up an attack, and vanishes when you die, the target dies, it drops to 0, or you use this again.

feature:feature:harbinger-of-doom.description: Ominous Rend deals +1d6 Necrotic, your damage to a doomed creature can be Necrotic, and Necrotic from you or the Grim ignores Resistance.

feature:feature:grave-bond.description: The Grim gains B/P/S Resistance; you gain Necrotic Resistance; and once per Omen, a Reaction makes the doomed target reroll a successful save with Disadvantage.

feature:feature:sealed-fate.description: Ominous Rend deals a further +1d6. Once per Long Rest (or a level 4+ slot), when you cast Omen of Doom the target makes a Cha save or is Vulnerable to the Grim's damage and your Omen damage.

feature:feature:hex-slinger.description: Cha mod times (min 1) per Short Rest, when you deal Sneak Attack damage designate two of the dice; their total sets a jinx until the end of the target's next turn. 2 Snake Eyes: it can only move or act or Bonus Act, taking 2d6 Psychic if it attacks your side. 3-4 The Nightmare: Frightened and it uses its Reaction to flee. 5-6 Whiskey Bottle: drops what it holds and fumbles pickups (DC 15 Dex). 7 Cheap Shot: half Speed and attacks against it have Advantage. 8-9 Withered Arm: Disadvantage on Strength D20 Tests. 10-11 Bad Luck: -1d6 on attacks and saves. 12 Dead Man: your next attack before the end of your next turn hits, or crits if it would hit (triple dice on a natural 20).

feature:feature:get-jinxed.description: Proficiency with two Gaming Sets. A 1-hour ritual makes a jinx weapon: a Gaming Set that works for you as a Simple Ranged weapon (30/90 feet, 1d8 Force, Vex mastery), a Pistol, or a proficient weapon that deals Force. Learn Dancing Lights, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Mysterious Presence, or Prestidigitation (Charisma).

feature:feature:borrowed-luck.description: Using Hex Slinger grants Heroic Inspiration; if you already have it you can spend it instead of a Hex Slinger use.

feature:feature:pick-your-poison.description: Roll the jinx dice twice and choose. Doubles also deal Psychic equal to half your level, and a 2 or 12 doesn't spend the use.

feature:feature:the-other-side.description: After a missed attack or failed save, spend and roll any number of Sneak Attack dice to add to it; when hit, spend them to add to your AC. Spent dice return after your next Sneak Attack.

feature:feature:blood-well.description: When you deal damage or restore HP, spend your Blood Well to add 1d8 for one target. It refills on a Long Rest or when a creature takes 10+ Necrotic from you at once.

feature:feature:crimson-spells.description: Always prepared at Sorcerer levels: 3 Aid, Blood Bolt, Cure Wounds, Inflict Wounds, Blood Sacrifice; 5 Crimson Harvest, Vampiric Touch; 7 Death Ward, Sacrificial Siphon; 9 Field of Reaping, Mass Cure Wounds.

feature:feature:pool-of-blood.description: As a Bonus Action spend your Blood Well to become a pool of blood for up to 1 hour: Speed 10 with climb, swim, and spider climb; B/P/S Resistance; immune to Prone; Advantage on Str, Dex, Con saves; squeeze through cracks and share spaces; but no speaking, attacking, casting, or using items.

feature:feature:scarlet-vigor.description: Resistance to Necrotic. After a Short Rest, spend your Blood Well to remove 1 Exhaustion level.

feature:feature:vital-siphoning.description: As a Bonus Action spend a Hit Die to refill your Blood Well, or spend the Blood Well to make your next Metamagic this turn free.

feature:feature:sanguine-feast.description: Once per Long Rest (or 5 Sorcery Points), as a Magic action chosen creatures within 30 feet make a Con save (with Disadvantage if your Blood Well is spent) for 5d8 Necrotic, half on success; you heal the damage roll if any are hurt.

feature:feature:great-fool-spells.description: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Disguise Self, Hideous Laughter, Rope Trick, Spiritual Weapon, Vicious Mockery; 5 Blink, Stinking Cloud; 7 Phantasmal Killer, Puppet Master; 9 Arcane Hand, Mislead.

feature:feature:killing-joke.description: Cha mod times (min 1) per Long Rest (one back on a Short Rest), when a creature you can see within 60 feet takes damage or fails a save, take a Reaction to cast Vicious Mockery on it.

feature:feature:jester-s-japes.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, as a Magic action a creature within 60 feet makes a Cha save or is cursed for 1 minute (repeat save each turn): Flower Spurt (Blinded), Clown Shoes (half Speed, Disadvantage on Dex checks and saves), Honk Honk (noisy and can't benefit from Invisible), or Jolly Arms (half damage with weapons and Unarmed Strikes).

feature:feature:mocking-banter.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, when a creature damages you, take a Reaction: it makes a Wis save, taking Psychic damage equal to the damage you took, or half on success.

feature:feature:send-in-the-clowns.description: Once per Long Rest, as a Magic action summon three ghostly fools for 1 minute and make up to three melee spell attacks against creatures within 60 feet (repeatable with your action on later turns): 2d10 Psychic and Frightened until its next turn ends, or Prone.

feature:feature:horned-king-spells.description: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Animal Friendship, Bane, Spike Growth, Suggestion; 5 Bestow Curse, Fly; 7 Phantasmal Killer, Polymorph; 9 Dominate Person, Scrying.

feature:feature:witch-mark.description: On a Long Rest, imbue a held Tiny object with one of your prepared action-time Warlock spells; whoever holds it can cast it once as a Magic action using your modifiers.

feature:feature:malediction.description: Cha mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, curse a creature within 60 feet until the end of its next turn as a Magic action, or as a Reaction when it targets you with an attack or spell. Agony: Disadvantage on its next attack or Concentration save. Hate: Disadvantage on its next Int, Wis, or Cha save. Rot: +1d10 Necrotic the next time it takes damage and no healing until its next turn ends.

feature:feature:spiteful-curse.description: Once per Long Rest (not spent if it saves), Malediction can cast Bestow Curse instead with 60-foot range, 1-minute duration, and no Concentration; on a successful save it suffers a Malediction curse instead.

feature:feature:crown-of-horns.description: Once per Long Rest (or a Pact slot), as a Bonus Action for 1 minute: once per turn your damage adds 1d8 Necrotic, and on activation and each turn a creature in a 20-foot aura makes a Cha save or until your next turn is Charmed, has Disadvantage on attacks and checks, or is Frightened and must flee.

feature:feature:gather-the-coven.description: A 1-hour ritual bonds up to six willing creatures: each can use one chosen Malediction Reaction once per Long Rest; once per Short or Long Rest you can teleport next to a bonded creature as a Bonus Action (free while Crowned); and while your Crown is active their first damage each turn adds 1d10 Necrotic.

feature:feature:forbidden-knowledge.description: Learn Deep Speech or another language, and always have one level 1 Warlock spell prepared (swap on a Long Rest).

feature:feature:intrusion.description: You have an Intrusion Die that starts at d6 (d8 at Wizard 5, d10 at 11, d12 at 17) and shifts along d2-d3-d4-d6-d8-d10-d12. Risking Intrusion: roll it; on 2+ nothing happens and it shrinks a step; on a 1 it grows a step and you roll a d12 Intrusion effect (from losing actions, warped space, or blindness to a free spell slot, a buffed DC, or a summoned Aberration or Fiend). It regrows a step on a Short Rest and resets on a Long Rest. When you cast a slot spell, risk Intrusion for Overwhelming Mind (Disadvantage on the first save) or Seeking Eye (Advantage on the first attack roll).

feature:feature:reality-tear.description: Always have one Warlock spell of level 3 or lower prepared (swap on a Long Rest). Risk Intrusion to cast it without Concentration (lasting up to 1 minute), or once per Long Rest trigger an automatic Intrusion to cast it without a slot.

feature:feature:occult-presence.description: Roll Intrusion effects twice and pick, or negate one by gaining 1 Exhaustion. Gain one benefit, swappable on a Long Rest or with an automatic Intrusion as a Bonus Action: immunity to Charmed, Frightened, and possession; Resistance to Necrotic and Psychic; or flight with hover at your Speed.

feature:feature:beyond-space.description: Scrying always prepared. Risk Intrusion to treat the target as if you had part of its body, or to cast it as an action. Once per Long Rest during the spell, trigger an automatic Intrusion to teleport yourself and willing creatures within 10 feet to spaces seen through the sensor.

feature:feature:alchemical-knowledge.description: Alchemist's Supplies with proficiency, usable as an Arcane Focus and to craft any magic item.

feature:feature:quintessence.description: Learn Dissolution; what it destroys (Small or larger) leaves an ounce of Quintessence. Hold up to twice your Int mod (min 2). Spend it as 100 GP of Material components per measure, as 50 GP of materials for scribing or crafting, or to turn one damage type of a spell into Force.

feature:feature:albedo.description: When casting with a slot, spend up to half your PB (round up) in Quintessence to raise the slot level by 1 each (max 9).

feature:feature:citrinitas.description: Creation and Fabricate always prepared, each once per Long Rest without a slot and as an action. Spend up to Int mod Quintessence on Creation to multiply its duration by 1 + the amount.

feature:feature:rubedo.description: After a rest, spend 10 Quintessence to make a philosopher's stone (AC 19, 20 HP, harmed only by Force). While carried: spend up to 2 Quintessence to raise a spell's DC by that much; a Reaction and 5 Quintessence turn a failed save into a success; you stop aging; and it counts as part of your body for Scrying and resurrection, serving as the component.

feature:feature:rage-of-the-giants.description: When you activate Rage, if smaller than Large you can become Large (with your gear) if there is room. While Large your carrying capacity doubles, you have Advantage on Strength checks and saves, and weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks deal one extra damage die.

feature:feature:crushing-steps.description: You can move through the space of any creature smaller than you. An enemy whose space you move through makes a Strength save (DC 8 + Strength modifier + Proficiency Bonus) or has the Prone condition and can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

feature:feature:titanic-strikes.description: Brutal Strike's Forceful Blow pushes twice as far, and Hamstring Blow reduces the target's Speed to 0 until the start of your next turn.

feature:feature:rage-of-the-titans.description: When you activate Rage, if smaller than Huge you can become Huge (or Large if there isn't room). While Huge your carrying capacity triples, your reach increases by 5 feet, you have Advantage on Strength checks and saves, and your attacks deal two extra damage dice.

feature:feature:poetic-provocation.description: You always have Vicious Mockery prepared (or learn another cantrip if you know it). A creature that fails its save against your Vicious Mockery also has Disadvantage on its next Wisdom, Intelligence, or Charisma save before the end of your next turn. Flyting Master: use Charisma (Performance) in place of Intimidation or Persuasion to provoke, threaten, or sway with words.

feature:feature:skald:martial-training.description: Proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Medium armor and Shields. You can use a Simple or Martial weapon as a Spellcasting Focus for Bard spells, and you gain the mastery property of one Simple or Martial weapon (change it after a Long Rest).

feature:feature:bragi-s-rune-of-speech.description: As a Bonus Action, expend a Bardic Inspiration for one effect (only one active at a time). Scorn: a creature within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save or has Disadvantage on attacks against you for 1 minute. Eloquence: add your Bardic Inspiration roll to your first Charisma check or save in the next hour. Vitality: you and up to three allies within 30 feet gain Temporary Hit Points equal to a Bardic Inspiration roll.

feature:feature:battle-sagas.description: Spend 1 minute reciting the Eddas; creatures of your choice within 60 feet that hear you gain for 1 hour: Resistance to Poison and Immunity to Frightened and Poisoned, +2d10 Hit Point maximum (and Hit Points), and +1d4 once per turn to an attack roll or save. During that hour, when an affected ally fails a d20 test, you can take a Reaction and expend a Bardic Inspiration to let it add the die. Once per Short or Long Rest.

feature:feature:domain-spells-2024.description: Always prepared at Cleric levels: 3 Augury, Bane, Bless, Warding Bond; 5 Bestow Curse, Counterspell; 7 Death Ward, Divination; 9 Commune, Modify Memory.

feature:feature:tailor-the-skein.description: After a Long Rest, roll a d6 twice and record the results as Skeins. As a Reaction after learning the result of an attack, damage roll, save, or ability check by a creature you can see within 60 feet, add or subtract one Skein from it. Each Skein is used once. The die becomes a d8 at level 7, d10 at 11, and d12 at 15.

feature:feature:plucking-at-threads.description: As a Bonus Action, expend a Channel Divinity: allies within 30 feet have Advantage on attack rolls and saves until the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:intertwined-fate.description: As a Magic action, expend a spell slot and choose two creatures you can see within 30 feet. The primary makes a Constitution save (it may choose to fail), taking 1d8 Force damage per slot level or half on a success. The secondary regains that many Hit Points, or gains them as Temporary Hit Points if uninjured.

feature:feature:skein-weaver.description: When you use Plucking at Threads, enemies within 30 feet make a Charisma save or have Disadvantage on attack rolls and saves for 1 minute (save at the end of each turn); a success grants immunity for 24 hours.

feature:feature:mantle-of-the-wolf.description: As an action, expend a Wild Shape use to manifest a spectral wolf's head for 10 minutes (ends if dismissed, re-manifested, or you are Incapacitated). You add your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1) to Strength (Athletics) checks and Strength saves, and you can replace one melee attack with a bite using Wisdom: 1d8 + Wisdom modifier Force.

feature:feature:circle-of-fenris-spells.description: Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Beast Sense, Enhance Ability, Ensnaring Strike, Hunter's Mark; 5 Conjure Animals, Fear; 7 Dominate Beast; 9 Commune with Nature.

feature:feature:improved-mantle.description: While the mantle is active: bite attacks deal double damage to objects and structures and ignore damage thresholds; Darkvision 60 feet (or +30 feet); and +10 feet Speed.

feature:feature:defend-the-pack.description: When a creature attacks an ally within 30 feet, take a Reaction and spend a Wild Shape use: a phantom wolf deals 4d8 Force (no roll or save) and knocks it Prone. 6d8 from level 14.

feature:feature:children-of-the-great-wo.description: Once per day when you take on your Mantle of the Wolf, also summon a loyal fenrikyn that obeys your telepathic commands for as long as the mantle lasts (or until dismissed, destroyed, you leave the plane, are killed or Unconscious, or it is more than 120 feet away).

feature:feature:seaborne.description: Advantage on Strength and Dexterity saves and checks to avoid being pushed, knocked Prone, or moved against your will, and on checks to pilot waterborne vehicles.

feature:feature:viking-weapon-mastery.description: If you have Weapon Mastery with a Battleaxe, Longsword, or Spear, once on each of your turns add your Proficiency Bonus to a damage roll with it.

feature:feature:savage-charge.description: As an Attack action, move up to your Speed and make one melee attack. On a hit, a Bonus Action Dash lets you pass through the target's space without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

feature:feature:call-of-the-northlands.description: At the end of a Long Rest choose one (replacing the previous): Dragonslayer (Advantage on attacks against Dragons), Hardy Swimmer (Swim Speed equal to Speed), Inured to Cold (Resistance to Cold), or Trollslayer (Advantage on attacks against Giants).

feature:feature:marauder-s-reprisal.description: When you become Bloodied or take a Critical Hit, use your Reaction to attack an enemy in reach; a hit is a Critical Hit and grants Temporary Hit Points equal to half your level. Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest.

feature:feature:unstoppable-assault.description: As an action once per Long Rest, attack additional times equal to half your Proficiency Bonus beyond your normal attacks; hits from these are Critical Hits and push the target 10 feet unless it succeeds on a Strength save (DC 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Strength modifier).

feature:feature:tenets-of-valhalla.description: Protect the worthy dead. Inspire courage in battle. Bring justice to those who make a mockery of the dead.

feature:feature:encouraging-smite.description: Right after casting Divine Smite, expend a Channel Divinity: creatures of your choice within 30 feet have Advantage on attacks and saves against the target until the start of your next turn, and their attacks against it deal an extra 1d4 Thunder.

feature:feature:guardian-of-the-dead.description: As a Bonus Action, expend a Channel Divinity for 1 hour: within 10 feet of a creature at 0 Hit Points you have Advantage on attacks and on saves against Charmed or Frightened (Immunity to Charmed once you have Aura of Courage). When a creature you can see casts a spell to create Undead or restore life, take a Reaction to move half your Speed and attack it.

feature:feature:oath-of-valhalla-spells.description: Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Heroism, Searing Smite; 5 Gentle Repose, Shining Smite; 9 Beacon of Hope, Glyph of Warding (Thunder); 13 Aura of Purity, Guardian of Faith; 17 Flame Strike, Hallow.

feature:feature:thunderous-aura.description: You and allies in your Aura of Protection have Immunity to Thunder damage. Your Find Steed mount's attacks can deal Thunder damage.

feature:feature:valorous-soul.description: When you reduce a foe to 0 Hit Points with a melee attack, allies of your choice within 60 feet have Advantage on attacks and saves for 1 minute. If you die, your body is preserved as by Gentle Repose, and you may refuse to be raised.

feature:feature:spirit-of-the-valkyrie.description: As a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: Fly Speed 60 feet; Advantage on saves against spells and magical effects; creatures in your Aura of Protection that try to create or summon Undead must succeed on a Charisma save or fail; Smite spells cast with any slot act as level 5; and enemies starting their turn in your aura take Thunder damage equal to your Charisma modifier + Proficiency Bonus and must make a Constitution save or be Stunned until the end of their next turn. Once per Long Rest, or restore it with a level 5 slot.

feature:feature:spirit-caller-spells.description: Always prepared at Sorcerer levels: 3 Bane, Bless, Heroism, Protection from Evil and Good; 5 Augury, Healing Spirit; 7 Speak with Dead, Spirit Guardians; 9 Aura of Life, Death Ward.

feature:feature:occult-expertise.description: Proficiency in Arcana and Religion, and you can use Charisma instead of Intelligence for them.

feature:feature:spirit-guidance.description: As a Bonus Action, give yourself Advantage on a skill check. Uses equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) per Long Rest.

feature:feature:spirit-aura.description: As a Bonus Action, create a 10-foot spirit aura around you or a willing ally for 1 minute. Maddening Whispers: an enemy entering or starting its turn there makes a Wisdom save or has Disadvantage on ability checks and attacks until the end of its next turn. Bolstering Whispers: allies entering or starting there have Advantage on ability checks and attacks until the end of their next turn. Twice per Long Rest, or again for 3 Sorcery Points.

feature:feature:spiritual-secrets.description: When you fail an ability check, attack roll, or save, reroll and take the new result. Uses equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) per Long Rest; spend 3 Sorcery Points for another.

feature:feature:spiritual-storm.description: Your spirit aura extends 15 feet, and enemies entering or starting their turn in it take 2d8 Psychic (once per turn).

feature:feature:context-switch.description: When a creature makes a melee attack against you, take a Reaction to swap places with a creature within 5 feet (Wisdom save if unwilling); it becomes the target and takes the damage, and an enemy so targeted has Disadvantage on attacks until the start of your next turn. Uses equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) per Long Rest.

feature:feature:trickster-spells.description: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Detect Thoughts, Disguise Self, Enlarge/Reduce, Magic Mouth, Silent Image; 5 Nondetection, Slow; 7 Compulsion, Confusion; 9 Animate Objects, Modify Memory.

feature:feature:nimble-trickery.description: Proficiency in Sleight of Hand, and Advantage on Sleight of Hand checks to swap an item for one of similar size. At level 6 you can swap with an unattended object up to 30 feet away; at level 14 you can replace it with a 1-minute illusion instead. Once per Long Rest, or restore by expending a Pact Magic slot.

feature:feature:distant-switch.description: Context Switch can target a creature within 30 feet, or the swapped creature has Disadvantage on its save. If the target fails, you can have the Invisible condition until the end of your next turn or until you attack, deal damage, or cast a spell.

feature:feature:painful-unreality.description: You automatically succeed on Study checks to tell if something is illusory. When a creature interacts with your Illusion spell and fails to see through it, you can force a Wisdom save: 4d10 Psychic and Stunned until the end of its next turn, or half damage only.

feature:feature:harbinger-of-chaos.description: As a Bonus Action, announce changes to reality. Enemies that can see and hear you make an Intelligence save; on a failure they have Disadvantage on d20 tests until the end of their next turn, and you and your allies have Advantage on attacks and d20 tests against them. Once per Short Rest.

feature:feature:cat-whisperer.description: You can understand and talk with felines, use any Influence action skill option with them, and have Advantage on those checks.

feature:feature:feline-nature.description: Climb Speed equal to your Speed; when you fall while not Incapacitated you land on your feet and subtract up to 20 feet from the fall for damage. Nine Lives: when reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed, immediately use Second Wind (no action) before falling Unconscious.

feature:feature:outsized-trickery.description: You can Shove creatures of any size. On a failed save, a pushed target goes 5 feet farther and takes Bludgeoning equal to half your Fighter level (round up) + Strength modifier; a knocked-Prone target takes Bludgeoning equal to half your Fighter level (round up).

feature:feature:pouncing-fighting-style.description: This subclass can take the Pouncing Fighting Style feat: after moving 15 feet or more toward a creature, +2 to your next melee or Unarmed Strike attack against it, or +2 to the DC of your Grapple or Shove.

feature:feature:evasive-maneuvers.description: Deft Cover: Half Cover while at least two Small or larger enemies are within 5 feet. Nimble Redirect: once per Short or Long Rest, when hit by a weapon or Unarmed Strike, take a Reaction to reduce the damage by your Fighter level and deal that much to a creature or object within 5 feet.

feature:feature:vigilant-reflexes.description: You can't be surprised unless Incapacitated. Right after rolling Initiative, take a Reaction to move up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and Hide as part of it.

feature:feature:cautious-tenacity.description: Two more uses of Second Wind, and using it grants the Dodge action's benefits until the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:swatting-flurry.description: Once per turn when you hit with a Melee weapon as part of the Attack action, make up to five more attack rolls against that target with it, stopping at the first miss; each hit deals 1d10 of the weapon's type with no added damage or effects.

feature:feature:beyond-coincidence.description: You have Fortune Dice (d20s) equal to half your Rogue level (round up), regained on a Long Rest. Spend one for a Luck check: a Charisma check with Expertise that nothing can modify. Favored Talent: replace any ability check with a Luck check. Lucky Break: as a Magic action, describe a lucky turn of events; the GM sets a DC by likelihood (5 to 9 extremely plausible, up to 30+ nearly impossible) and it happens on a success. Discuss this subclass with your GM first.

feature:feature:cup-half-full.description: When you or a creature within 60 feet rolls a 20 on a meaningful D20 Test, regain one Fortune Die.

feature:feature:lucky-strike.description: Spend a Fortune Die to make a Luck check in place of an attack roll; a hit triggers Sneak Attack even if it otherwise wouldn't (once per turn). Withdraw on this attack costs no Sneak Attack dice.

feature:feature:boon-of-fortuity.description: After a Long Rest roll two d20s and record them. Once per turn, before targets roll, replace the DC of a save forced by a creature you can see with one of these rolls. Unused rolls are lost on a Long Rest.

feature:feature:the-skin-of-your-teeth.description: Roll three d20s for Boon of Fortuity. When you or an ally within 60 feet takes 100 damage or less, replace the damage with one of your fortuitous rolls.

feature:feature:your-coven.description: Choose a coven: Crowsworn, Cloud Cap Coven, Fish Head Coven, League of the Gilded Gourd, Patchwork Robe Coven, or The Tall Hats. It sets your Coven's Bond and Voice of the Many options.

feature:feature:coven-patron-obojima:cov.description: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Animal Friendship, Bless, Borrow Magic, Mirror Image, Shared Vision; 5 Bestow Curse, Clairvoyance; 7 Pacify Monster, Polymorph; 9 Awaken, Telepathic Bond.

feature:feature:collective-knowledge.description: Borrowed Talent: once per Long Rest, gain proficiency with a skill or tool you are checking (no action), or learn a language as a Magic action, until your next Long Rest. Spell Swap: once per Long Rest, a 10-minute ritual lets you ask a coven witch one yes/no question and swap a prepared level 1+ Warlock spell for a Druid or Wizard spell of the same or lower level until your next Long Rest, casting it once without a slot.

feature:feature:coven-s-bond.description: Once per Long Rest as a Bonus Action, bond with a creature within 60 feet for 1 hour, using its effect up to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) times. Crowsworn or Fish Head: bond an enemy; when you take damage, halve it and the bound creature takes the same amount. Cloud Cap or Tall Hats: bond a willing creature; when either of you fails a save, the other can make it and lend the result. Gilded Gourd or Patchwork Robe: bond a willing creature; as a Bonus Action teleport to it, bring it to you, or swap places within 60 feet.

feature:feature:distant-protections.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, when an enemy deals you 10 or more damage, take a Reaction to regain 1d10 + Charisma modifier Hit Points and gain +5 AC, the Invisible condition, or a Fly Speed equal to your Speed until the end of your next turn. It triggers automatically when you drop to 0 but aren't killed.

feature:feature:voice-of-the-many.description: Once per Long Rest, by coven. Fish Head or Gilded Gourd: as a Magic action, cast a level 6 or lower Druid or Wizard Evocation spell (not a Reaction spell) without a slot or Material components. Cloud Cap or Crowsworn: as a Bonus Action roll three d6 and assign them as bonuses to AC and two saves for 1 minute. Patchwork Robe or Tall Hats: when you or a creature you can see is targeted by a spell of level 6 or lower, take a Reaction to make it also target any other creature you can see.

feature:feature:galvanic-heart.description: Resistance to Lightning damage (if you already have it, also reduce Lightning damage by d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus). Vessel save DC is 8 + Constitution modifier + Proficiency Bonus. Vessel Damage is d4s equal to your Rage Damage bonus, always Lightning.

feature:feature:unbound-storm.description: While raging: Electrified Chains (Bonus Action; your next hit this turn deals Vessel Damage and ensnares the target until your next turn, and moving more than 10 feet requires an Athletics check against your DC or it takes Vessel Damage and its Speed drops to 0); Fulgurant Strike (after a melee hit, a Bonus Action calls lightning through your weapon: Vessel Damage to the target and creatures in a 10-foot Emanation that fail a Dexterity save); Lightning Step (Bonus Action move half your Speed, dealing Vessel Damage to one creature within 5 feet where you stop).

feature:feature:roaring-crash.description: As part of entering Rage, leap to a space within 30 feet not occupied by a Huge or larger creature; creatures in a 10-foot Emanation make a Dexterity save, twice your Vessel Damage or half. A creature in the landing space has Disadvantage and is pushed 5 feet (or knocked Prone). 60 feet and Huge spaces at level 10; 90 feet and any creature at 14.

feature:feature:lightning-reflexes.description: Add your Constitution modifier (minimum +1) to Dexterity checks, including Initiative. While raging, Lightning Step once per turn costs no Bonus Action.

feature:feature:electric-beast.description: Add your Constitution modifier to Vessel Damage. Chains trigger on 5 feet of movement and also deny Reactions; Fulgurant Strike's Emanation is 20 feet and spares up to your Constitution modifier creatures; Lightning Step moves your full Speed and can teleport.

feature:feature:circle-of-symbiosis-spel.description: Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Arm Cannon, Calcified Memories, Fractured Shell, Phalangeal Shot, Shillelagh; 5 Displacing Maw, Osseous Impalement; 7 Dread Scarecrow, Maiden of Bones; 9 Forest of Dread, Tree Stride.

feature:feature:grafted-powers.description: Choose one: Bear Back (count one size larger for carrying and grappling, and add Wisdom to Strength checks), Deer Head (Advantage on Perception), or Goat Hooves (Advantage against Prone and a Climb Speed equal to your Speed).

feature:feature:wickerbone-behemoth.description: As a Bonus Action without armor or Shield, spend a Wild Shape use to become a behemoth for 10 minutes: your arms are Shillelagh Clubs whose mastery you can use, you are under Barkskin without Concentration, creatures of your choice within 5 feet take 1d4 Piercing when they damage you with an attack (2d4 at level 10), and at the start of each turn you regain half the damage taken since your last turn (up to five times your Proficiency Bonus).

feature:feature:circle-of-symbiosis:extr.description: Attack twice when you take the Attack action, and you can replace one attack with a cantrip.

feature:feature:circle-of-symbiosis:natu.description: You are permanently under Barkskin. While a behemoth you are Large, and taking the Attack action gives Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing until the end of your next turn (lost early if you take Fire damage).

feature:feature:briarheart.description: While a behemoth your arms also use the Nick mastery, and after taking the Attack action you can cast an action-time Osteomancy spell as a Bonus Action.

feature:feature:blood-strike.description: Learn three Blood Strike options (one more at levels 5, 9, 13, and 17; swap one each time). Once per turn on an Attack action weapon attack, apply one; you take its Blood Cost in unpreventable Necrotic damage. Uses equal to 1 + Constitution modifier per Short or Long Rest; save DC 8 + Constitution modifier + Proficiency Bonus. Options: Bewitching (1d8: +2d6 Psychic and Wisdom save or it treats an ally as an enemy), Bloodboil (1d6: 2d6 Fire ignoring Resistance in a 10-foot Emanation and burning), Bloodshard (1d8: a 60-foot Line, Dexterity save for weapon damage +1d6 Piercing or half), Constraining (1d8: +2d6 Acid, Disadvantage on its next attack, and a Dexterity save or 2d6 Acid when it moves), Exiling (1d10: Charisma save or banished until the end of its next turn), Hunting (1d4: ignores AC from armor, Shields, and magic; +1d6 Slashing and you track it for a minute), Shadowblood (1d6: +2d6 Necrotic and magical Darkness in 10 feet), Thunderblood (1d4: +2d6 Thunder, pushed 15 feet, Strength save or Prone), Withering (1d6: +2d6 Necrotic and Constitution save or its damage is halved). Damage dice improve at level 18.

feature:feature:blood-hound-anatomy.description: Immune to magical contagions, Resistance to Poison damage, and Advantage on saves against Poisoned. Advantage on Investigation, Perception, and Survival checks to find a creature with blood that you have damaged.

feature:feature:blood-armament.description: Your wielded weapon is blood-coated and can deal Acid, Necrotic, or Poison damage instead of its normal type.

feature:feature:blood-explosion.description: When you miss with a blood-coated weapon, a Bonus Action detonates it: the target and others in a 5-foot Emanation make a Constitution save, taking weapon damage or half.

feature:feature:blood-of-creation.description: Reroll a Blood Cost and take the lower result, and swap one Blood Strike option after each Long Rest.

feature:feature:blood-symphony.description: Using a Blood Strike heals you by your Constitution modifier (minimum 1), and a target that dies within 1 minute of a Blood Strike restores a use.

feature:feature:improved-blood-strike.description: Your Blood Strike options deal more damage, as noted in each option.

feature:feature:hunt-the-prey.description: As a Bonus Action, spend a Channel Divinity to mark a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute; then and as a Bonus Action on later turns, teleport up to 60 feet to a space within 5 feet of it while you can see it. If it drops to 0, move the mark to another creature within 60 feet.

feature:feature:oath-of-the-eldritch-hun.description: Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Faerie Fire, Spectral Slash; 5 Hold Person, Moonbeam; 9 Displacing Maw, Spectral Fury; 13 Evard's Black Tentacles, Maiden of Bones; 17 Contact Other Plane, Hold Monster.

feature:feature:stolen-eldritch-gift.description: Add your Charisma modifier to Athletics, Perception, and Survival checks.

feature:feature:sharpened-senses.description: You learn the Immunities, Resistances, and Vulnerabilities of creatures in your Aura of Protection, and have Blindsight within its range.

feature:feature:relentless-pursuit.description: When you hit your marked target with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike right after teleporting with Hunt the Prey, cast Divine Smite without a Bonus Action (once per turn).

feature:feature:perfect-hunter.description: As a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: weapon attacks deal +1d8 Necrotic ignoring Resistance and Immunity; Immunity to Grappled, Paralyzed, and Restrained; and the Invisible condition. Once per Long Rest, or restore with a level 5 slot.

feature:feature:torturer-conclave:tools-.description: Proficiency and Expertise with Torture Tools and Insight. An hour with the tools on a Restrained creature inflicts Exhaustion (and possibly 10 damage on a failed Dexterity check against 20 minus its Constitution modifier), and Intimidation against a creature you've used them on gets +twice your Proficiency Bonus.

feature:feature:torturer-techniques.description: With Torture Tools at hand, add one technique to a melee or Unarmed Strike hit once per turn; each technique twice per Long Rest (spend a Favored Enemy use to restore one). Empower by expending a slot (level 1 at Ranger 3 up to level 5 at 17) for extra damage of Wisdom modifier times slot level and -1d4 per slot level on the target's save. Save DC 8 + Wisdom modifier + Proficiency Bonus. Combing (+1d10 Slashing; from level 7, two rounds running causes decay), Enucleation (+1d6 and Constitution save or Disadvantage on Perception and Blinded beyond 60 feet), Hamstringing (+1d6 Slashing and Constitution save or Speed 0 until your next turn), Nerve Scraping (+1d4 Psychic and Constitution save or it must attack a random creature), Throat Chop (+1d8 Bludgeoning and it can't speak or cast verbal spells; from level 11, two rounds running can Stun), Tympanic Rupture (+1d8 Bludgeoning and Constitution save or Deafened for 1 minute).

feature:feature:depraved-mind.description: Immunity to Frightened and Resistance to Psychic. A creature trying to read or speak into your mind against your will must succeed on a Wisdom save or take Psychic damage equal to your level and fail.

feature:feature:veil-of-pain.description: When a technique damages a creature, it makes a Wisdom save or you are Invisible to it for 1 minute (save each turn). Wisdom modifier uses per Long Rest.

feature:feature:mental-agony.description: When a creature within 60 feet that failed a save against your technique since your last turn makes an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma save, take a Reaction to make it subtract 1d10 (not against Fright-immune creatures).

feature:feature:sanctified-champion.description: Proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Medium armor. After a Short Rest, sanctify a Piercing or Slashing melee weapon: it has Finesse for you and ignores Resistance of Aberrations, Fiends, and Undead.

feature:feature:divine-blessings.description: Divine Points equal to 1 + Wisdom modifier per Short or Long Rest, and regain one when your sanctified blade kills an Aberration, Beast, Fiend, or Undead of CR 1/2+. Save DC 8 + Wisdom modifier + Proficiency Bonus. Armor of the Faithful (Reaction, 1: the attacker makes a Wisdom save or must retarget and can't target you until your next turn); Divine Inspiration (1: reroll a History, Religion, or Insight check and add your Wisdom modifier); Rend the Blasphemous (Bonus Action after attacking, 1: another blade attack adding your Wisdom modifier to hit).

feature:feature:righteous-armament.description: Chains of Judgement (1 on a hit: Strength save or Radiant equal to Wisdom modifier and Restrained until the end of your next turn); Divine Retaliation (Reaction, 1: when hit in melee, attack back adding your Wisdom modifier to damage); Erupting Blades (2, forgoing Sneak Attack: a 45-foot Line takes your Sneak Attack damage as Radiant, Dexterity save for half).

feature:feature:saintly-revelations.description: Learn two Cleric cantrips. Heroism, Protection from Evil and Good, and Shield of Faith are always prepared and castable at will on yourself without slots or components (Wisdom); from level 17 they need no Concentration but only one is active at a time.

feature:feature:final-judgement.description: Divine Spirits: once per Long Rest (or 3 Divine Points), cast Spirit Guardians without a slot; creatures in it count as next to an ally for Sneak Attack. Radiant Blade: on command your blade sheds light 30 feet, counts as magic, and deals +2d4 Radiant.

feature:feature:brittle-bone-armor.description: As an action without armor or Shield, gain Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Wizard level for 1 hour; while they last you have Resistance to Piercing and Slashing and +2 AC. Once per Long Rest, or restore with a level 2+ slot.

feature:feature:anatomical-expert.description: Proficiency in Medicine; add your Intelligence modifier to Medicine and Survival checks, with Expertise when they concern a creature with a skeleton.

feature:feature:bone-puppetry.description: As a Magic action, a creature with a skeleton within 60 feet makes a Strength save or you control its actions until the end of its next turn (it attacks allies with Disadvantage and they have Advantage on saves against it). One at a time; Intelligence modifier uses per Long Rest.

feature:feature:skeletal-mastery.description: Cast Alter Self without a slot or Concentration (Change Appearance or Natural Weapons only). As a Magic action dissolve or restore your skeleton: boneless you have Speed 10, squeeze through 1-inch gaps, count as Prone, and can't use hands, attack, or cast (a Bonus Action regrows hand bones until your next turn).

feature:feature:improved-bone-puppetry.description: Control lasts 1 minute with full obedience (save each turn), requiring Concentration that damage can't break; spend another use to impose Disadvantage on its save.

feature:feature:instinctual-divination.description: When you take the Study action to make an Arcana or Religion check, you can make it as a Wisdom (Survival) check instead.

feature:feature:spell-hammer.description: Once per turn while raging, deal double your Rage Damage bonus with a Strength-based hit, or triple against a target that has Legendary Actions, can cast spells, or was summoned.

feature:feature:path-of-the-spell-scorne.description: While raging, you and allies in a 30-foot Emanation add your Rage Damage bonus to saves against spells.

feature:feature:sunder-the-weave.description: Counterspell is always prepared; once per Short or Long Rest while raging cast it without a slot or components (Strength), and as part of that Reaction move up to your Speed and make one weapon attack against the caster.

feature:feature:bolstering-howl.description: When you or a creature that can hear you takes damage, take a Reaction to give it Resistance to that damage and that type until the end of the turn.

feature:feature:dimensional-duel.description: Banishment is always prepared. When you rage or as a Bonus Action while raging, cast it without a slot or components (Strength) on up to three creatures, maintaining Concentration while raging, and you can follow them into a lit demiplane of 30 to 200 feet where they aren't Incapacitated. Strength modifier uses per Long Rest.

feature:feature:tragic-hero.description: When you fail a save, other creatures you choose within 60 feet add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to their saves against the same effect.

feature:feature:one-life-many-roles.description: Once per Short or Long Rest as a Bonus Action, cast Disguise Self; copying a creature you can see also copies its mannerisms and voice.

feature:feature:stage-direction.description: When a creature that can see you would roll your Bardic Inspiration die, it uses the die's maximum instead. Charisma modifier uses per Long Rest.

feature:feature:assemble-the-troupe.description: Your One Life, Many Roles Disguise Self can also disguise up to six willing creatures within 30 feet as you choose, and disguised creatures add your Charisma modifier to Charisma checks.

feature:feature:grand-finale.description: Once per Long Rest as a Magic action, up to two other creatures within 60 feet that see or hear you can immediately take an action.

feature:feature:apocalypse-domain-spells.description: Always prepared at Cleric levels: 3 Darkness, Hellish Rebuke, Phantasmal Force, Thunderwave; 5 Doom, Fear; 7 Blight, Ice Storm; 9 Antilife Shell, Insect Plague.

feature:feature:visions-of-annihilation.description: As a Bonus Action, attacks against a creature you can see within 120 feet have Advantage until the start of your next turn. Wisdom modifier uses per Long Rest.

feature:feature:doom-song.description: As a Bonus Action, spend a Channel Divinity: for 10 minutes attacks against a creature you can see within 120 feet crit on 19 or 20.

feature:feature:all-will-be-dust.description: As a Bonus Action, spend a Channel Divinity: a creature you can see within 120 feet has Disadvantage on its next save against your spells before the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:life-beyond-death.description: When you or an ally within 120 feet is about to make a Death Saving Throw, expend a spell slot (no action) to heal it ten times the slot level.

feature:feature:circle-of-the-symbiote-s.description: Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Barkskin, Entangle, Guidance; 5 Plant Growth; 7 Hallucinatory Terrain; 9 Tree Stride.

feature:feature:primal-symbiote.description: Advantage on Constitution saves to maintain Concentration. Symbiotic Transformation: as a Bonus Action, spend a Wild Shape use for 1 minute of +2 AC, Temporary Hit Points of 2 + half your Druid level at the start of each turn, and Advantage on Stealth.

feature:feature:symbiotic-reflexes.description: Haste is always prepared, and once per Symbiotic Transformation you can cast it on yourself without a slot or components.

feature:feature:survival-instinct.description: While Incapacitated you can still Dash, Disengage, or Dodge, and keep the Dodge benefits while Incapacitated.

feature:feature:surge-of-sustenance.description: Once per Long Rest as a Magic action, spend a Wild Shape use to give yourself or a creature you touch the benefits of a Short Rest.

feature:feature:bolstering-presence.description: At the start of your turn (no action), creatures of your choice within 30 feet that see or hear you regain 2d6 + half your Fighter level Hit Points. Charisma modifier uses per Long Rest.

feature:feature:heroic-effort.description: At the end of a creature's turn, take a Reaction to move your Speed and make one attack; then an ally within 30 feet can use its Reaction to do the same. Charisma modifier uses per Long Rest.

feature:feature:lead-by-example.description: Heroic Effort ends Charmed, Frightened, or Poisoned on you and on the ally you choose.

feature:feature:inspiring-presence.description: Creatures you bolster add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to D20 Tests and damage rolls until the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:durable-presence.description: Bolstering Presence recharges on a Short or Long Rest.

feature:feature:mighty-effort.description: Heroic Effort can include up to three allies.

feature:feature:guardian-of-the-way-tech.description: Once per turn when a Flurry of Blows Unarmed Strike deals damage: Anchoring Strike (the target can't teleport or travel between planes until the end of your next turn) or Banishing Strike (teleport the target up to 15 feet to a space you can see).

feature:feature:seeker.description: Detect Magic and Comprehend Languages are always prepared; once per Long Rest (or for 1 Focus Point) cast one without a slot or components (Wisdom).

feature:feature:warden-of-harmony.description: When a creature within 60 feet tries to teleport, take a Reaction and spend 1 Focus Point to stop it.

feature:feature:cosmic-restoration.description: Once per Long Rest (or for 4 Focus Points), as a Bonus Action touch a willing creature to end spells of your choice on it, or remove Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Stunned, or one Exhaustion level.

feature:feature:ward-the-profane.description: Once per turn on an Unarmed Strike hit, spend 3 Focus Points to cast Banishment on the target (Wisdom).

feature:feature:tenets-of-the-guardian.description: Choose up to four ideals matching your alignment, such as Courage, Sacrifice, Service, Fidelity, Protection, Affinity, Beauty, Freedom, Dominance, Opportunism, or Profit.

feature:feature:oath-of-the-guardian-spe.description: Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Alarm, Shield of Faith; 5 Lesser Restoration, Warding Bond; 9 Beacon of Hope, Protection from Energy; 13 Death Ward, Guardian of Faith; 17 Greater Restoration, Raise Dead.

feature:feature:defensive-intervention.description: When a creature you can see hits another creature within 30 feet with an attack roll, take a Reaction and spend a Channel Divinity to teleport up to 30 feet into range and become the target.

feature:feature:marking-strike.description: When you hit with a weapon, forgo its mastery to mark the target until the end of your next turn: it has Disadvantage on attacks against others and spends 2 feet per foot moving away from you.

feature:feature:guarding-presence.description: As a Bonus Action, up to your Charisma modifier creatures within 5 feet use your AC while they stay within 5 feet.

feature:feature:inspiring-defense.description: You and creatures under your Guarding Presence make two attacks with each Opportunity Attack.

feature:feature:ward-of-the-guardian.description: When a creature you've marked drops an ally to 0 without killing it, take a Reaction to leave the ally at 1 Hit Point, and it can use its Reaction to make a melee attack against the marked creature. Charisma modifier uses per Long Rest.

feature:feature:guardian-angel.description: Once per Long Rest (or with a level 5 slot), as a Bonus Action for 1 minute: Guarding Presence becomes a 100-foot Emanation, you regain a Channel Divinity on any turn you have none, and once per round use Ward of the Guardian without a Reaction.

feature:feature:trail-warden-spells.description: Always prepared at Ranger levels: 3 Goodberry; 5 Pass Without Trace; 9 Spirit Guardians; 13 Guardian of Faith; 17 Mass Cure Wounds.

feature:feature:coordinated-tactics.description: Roll your Teamwork Die (d6; d8 at level 11, d10 at 17) at the start of each turn. Coordinated Strikes: when another creature you can see hits, take a Reaction to add the die to the damage. Coordinated Tactics: after rolling, willing creatures within 60 feet that see you can use their Reactions to move up to five times the roll (or their Speed) without provoking or Difficult Terrain.

feature:feature:lead-the-way.description: When you succeed on a check with a skill you have Expertise in, chosen creatures within 60 feet add your Teamwork Die to the same check until the start of your next turn.

feature:feature:tactical-assault.description: Allies you move with Coordinated Tactics also gain one: Guardian Maneuver (reduce the first damage they take by the Teamwork Die) or Recon Maneuver (Hide as part of the move, adding the die to Stealth).

feature:feature:coordinated-effort.description: When you roll Initiative and aren't Incapacitated, roll the Teamwork Die; you and allies within 30 feet that see or hear you add it to Initiative.

feature:feature:group-assault.description: When all your attacks in an Attack action target one creature, chosen creatures within 60 feet add your Teamwork Die to one attack and damage roll against it.

feature:feature:shadowy-reflection.description: As a Magic action, detach your shadow into a space within 5 feet; later control it as a Magic action or with your Cunning Action, moving it your Speed to manipulate objects, open unlocked doors, or carry up to 10 pounds. It can't attack and vanishes if damaged, targeted, or you are Incapacitated.

feature:feature:shadow-motes.description: You have Shadow Motes equal to your Rogue level per Long Rest, regaining one when you drop a hostile creature to 0. Shadow Scout (1: as a Magic action, see and hear through your shadow for 1 minute up to 120 feet away); Shadow Swap (1, with Cunning Action: swap places with your shadow); Vexing Shadow (1, after a weapon hit with your shadow within 5 feet of the target: you are Invisible to it until the end of your next turn).

feature:feature:shadowed-succor.description: Once per Long Rest, Uncanny Dodge reduces the damage to 0.

feature:feature:shadow-gate.description: As a Bonus Action with your shadow within 5 feet, spend 4 Shadow Motes to cast Dimension Door (Intelligence); your shadow travels too.

feature:feature:true-shadow.description: Once per Long Rest as a Bonus Action, your shadow becomes a substantial duplicate for 1 hour that can Attack, Hide, or Utilize using your statistics when you control it, and your attacks against creatures within 5 feet of it have Advantage.

feature:feature:innate-darkness-spells.description: Always prepared at Sorcerer levels: 3 Confounding Shadows, Darkness, Tide of Darkness, Umbral Tendril; 5 Fear, Shadowy Eruption; 7 Black Tentacles, Greater Invisibility; 9 Mislead, Summon Shadow.

feature:feature:shadowed-soul.description: Darkvision 60 feet (or +60 feet), and you can see through magical Darkness you create with your Innate Darkness spells unless Blinded or Incapacitated.

feature:feature:friends-to-darkness.description: When you cast an Innate Darkness spell, up to your Charisma modifier creatures can see through your magical Darkness for 1 minute.

feature:feature:pure-darkness.description: Darkvision and Blindsight can't see into Darkness created by your Innate Darkness spells.

feature:feature:one-with-darkness.description: On your turn you are Invisible, even to Truesight and Blindsight, and if you haven't moved you can teleport up to 30 feet to a space you can see (then your Speed is 0 for the turn).

feature:feature:feline-spells.subclass: Exalted Assembly of the Feline Court
feature:feature:feline-spells.description: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Animal Friendship, Cat's Spring, Feather Fall, Feline Grace, Misty Step, Speak with Animals; 5 Haste, Phantom Panther; 7 Freedom of Movement, Dimension Door; 9 Feline Chaos, Telekinesis.

feature:feature:feline-affinity.subclass: Exalted Assembly of the Feline Court
feature:feature:feline-affinity.description: Cast Speak with Animals without a slot, but only to talk with cats.

feature:feature:feline-form.subclass: Exalted Assembly of the Feline Court
feature:feature:feline-form.description: As a Bonus Action, become a Cat for hours equal to half your Warlock level, keeping your Hit Points, mental scores, class features, languages, feats, and proficiencies. You can cast only Feline Spells (without Material components), and casting a non-hostile spell while Hidden keeps you Invisible. Charisma modifier uses per Long Rest.

feature:feature:vexing-distraction.subclass: Exalted Assembly of the Feline Court
feature:feature:vexing-distraction.description: In cat form, as a Bonus Action a creature within 5 feet that can see and hear you makes a Wisdom save or you choose: Annoy (Disadvantage on D20 Tests), Confound (Speed 0), or Distract (a creature you choose has Total Cover from it) until the end of your next turn. Charisma modifier uses per Long Rest.

feature:feature:nine-lives.subclass: Exalted Assembly of the Feline Court
feature:feature:nine-lives.description: You have nine lives per Long Rest: spend 1 to avoid a death save failure from damage at 0 (2 for a critical), 1 to succeed on a death save, 5 to turn it into a 20, 1 to survive massive damage at 0, 1 to drop to 1 instead of 0, or 9 to ignore an instant-death effect.

feature:feature:summon-the-courtiers.subclass: Exalted Assembly of the Feline Court
feature:feature:summon-the-courtiers.description: When a creature within 60 feet damages you, take a Reaction: spectral cats deal it 5d10 Force and leave it Blinded and Prone until the end of your next turn. Once per Long Rest, or restore with a Pact Magic slot.

feature:feature:book-learning.description: Touching a text for 1 minute grants a working knowledge of it unless coded. For a magic book or script, you learn its properties, attunement, charges, active spells, and the spell that made it.

feature:feature:edit-spell.description: Choose a level 1+ spell in your spellbook; prepared versions can gain +1 save DC, a different damage type, and/or an Intelligence save instead of the normal one, and can be prepared multiple times with different edits (each counts as prepared). Change the choice after a Long Rest.

feature:feature:weaver-of-words.description: You learn all languages available in the campaign.

feature:feature:customized-spell.description: Choose a level 1+ Concentration spell with a Verbal component and name a willing creature other than you when you prepare it; cast on that creature alone, it needs no Concentration.

feature:feature:master-of-words.description: When you prepare spells, link two level 1 to 5 one-action Verbal spells into one prepared spell of their combined level (maximum 6); casting it as a Magic action produces both effects.

feature:feature:tool-proficiency.description: Proficiency with Smith's Tools (or another Artisan's Tool if you already have it). Crafting an ordinary or magic weapon takes half the time.

feature:feature:forge-adept-spells.description: Always prepared: Armor of Agathys, Shield of Faith (3); Spiritual Weapon, Warding Bond (5); Beacon of Hope, Remove Curse (9); Death Ward, Fire Shield (13); Banishing Smite, Wall of Force (17).

feature:feature:forge-adept:battle-ready.description: Use Intelligence for attack and damage rolls with magic weapons. Proficiency with Martial weapons, and you can use a weapon you're proficient with as your Artificer spellcasting focus.

feature:feature:ghaal-shaarat.description: As a Magic action with Smith's Tools in hand, imbue a Simple or Martial melee weapon with your spirit until you imbue another or die. While you wield it, it is magic with a +1 bonus to attack and damage, has the Thrown property (30/120), and returns to your hand after a ranged attack.

feature:feature:forge-adept:extra-attack.description: You attack twice when you take the Attack action.

feature:feature:runes-of-war.description: Your Ghaal'Shaarat bonus becomes +2. Aura of War: as a Magic action, a 30-foot Emanation for 1 minute; you and allies in it deal an extra 1d4 Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage (your choice) on weapon or Unarmed Strike hits. Uses equal to your Intelligence modifier per Long Rest.

feature:feature:perfect-weapon.description: Your Ghaal'Shaarat bonus becomes +3, and on your first attack each turn you can shift some or all of it to your AC until your next turn. Hits deal an extra 1d6 Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder (and can deal that type instead of the normal one). Resistance to Psychic, and immunity to Charmed and Frightened.

feature:feature:weapon-of-legend-variant.description: With DM permission, replaces Soul of Artifice. While wielding your Ghaal'Shaarat: Aura of War is always active (Bonus Action to change its type); enemies starting their turn in it take its extra damage; as a Bonus Action raise the aura to 2d6 for 1 minute, Intelligence modifier times per Long Rest.

feature:feature:maverick:tool-proficienc.description: Proficiency with Tinker's Tools (or another Artisan's Tool if you already have it). Crafting a magic item takes half the time.

feature:feature:maverick-spells.description: Learn one cantrip from the Artificer, Cleric, or Wizard list. When you prepare spells, prepare extra spells equal to your Proficiency Bonus from the Artificer, Cleric, or Wizard lists; all count as Artificer spells.

feature:feature:arcane-prototype.description: At the end of a Long Rest with Tinker's Tools, spend Arcane Charges (spell level each) to build prototypes holding spells from the Artificer, Cleric, or Wizard lists. Only you can cast from them, without a slot, preparation, or material components; a prototype crumbles after use unless you expend a slot of the spell's level. Prototypes/max level/charges: 1/1/1 at 3, 2/2/3 at 5, 3/3/5 at 9, 3/4/7 at 13, 4/5/9 at 15, 4/6/11 at 17, 5/6/13 at 20.

feature:feature:fine-tuning.description: With Tinker's Tools on you, add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of an Artificer spell.

feature:feature:work-in-progress.description: After a Short Rest, swap one prepared spell for another from the Artificer, Cleric, or Wizard list.

feature:feature:final-breakthrough.description: After a Short Rest, swap a prototype's spell for another of the same level from those lists. You ignore class, species, spell, and level requirements for attuning to or using magic items.

feature:feature:improved-genius-variant-.description: With DM permission, replaces Soul of Artifice. Once per Long Rest as a Magic action, cast any spell of level 8 or lower, ignoring its casting time, components, and requirements.

feature:feature:broad-inspiration.description: Learn Guidance (doesn't count against cantrips). When you give Bardic Inspiration, you can give the same die to a second creature in range.

feature:feature:keeper-of-history.description: Proficiency in History and Performance, or Expertise in either you already have.

feature:feature:commanding-voice.description: When you take the Attack or Magic action, two creatures holding your Bardic Inspiration can spend it to use their Reaction for one weapon attack or Unarmed Strike, adding the die to damage on a hit.

feature:feature:battle-hymn.description: As a Bonus Action, sing until the start of your next turn (heard within 60 feet); allies within 30 feet who hear you add 1d4 to ability checks and saving throws.

feature:feature:mind-domain-spells.description: Always prepared: Command, Detect Thoughts, Dissonant Whispers, Mind Spike (3); Clairvoyance, Fear (5); Confusion, Phantasmal Killer (7); Synaptic Static, Telekinesis (9).

feature:feature:psychic-feedback.description: When a creature within 30 feet that you can see succeeds on a Wisdom save, use your Reaction and a Channel Divinity to impose Disadvantage on that save.

feature:feature:psychic-force.description: Cleric spells that deal Radiant can deal Psychic instead, and spells that deal Psychic add your Charisma modifier to damage against one target.

feature:feature:gestalt-anchor.description: You and allies in a 10-foot Emanation gain +2 to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves (inactive while you're Incapacitated; only one Gestalt Anchor applies at a time).

feature:feature:bend-reality.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, when an ally within 30 feet that you can see fails a save, change the roll to a 20.

feature:feature:skin-of-steel.description: In Wild Shape: max CR equals Druid level / 3; AC is 15 + Wisdom modifier if higher; Resistance to Poison and Advantage on saves against Poisoned; no Exhaustion from hunger, thirst, or suffocation, no need to sleep, and immune to magical sleep. Your form is obviously warforged-like.

feature:feature:circle-of-the-forged-spe.description: Always prepared: Blade Ward, Identify, Mirror Image (3); Haste (5); Fire Shield (7); Animate Objects (9).

feature:feature:elementally-imbued.description: Wild Shape attacks can deal Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning. Once per turn on a hit, expend a slot for +1d6 per slot level (max 5d6) of a chosen type; Constitution save or a 1-minute effect (save ends each turn): Acid lowers AC by half your Wisdom modifier, Cold sets Speed to 0 with Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks, Fire deals Wisdom-modifier damage each turn, Lightning blocks Opportunity Attacks and gives Disadvantage on its first attack each turn.

feature:feature:adamantine-hide.description: In Wild Shape, Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing. When hit by an attack or forced to save, use your Reaction and a Wild Shape use to shift into a form.

feature:feature:construction-perfection.description: In Wild Shape, AC is 16 + Wisdom modifier if higher, and you are immune to Poison damage and to Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned.

feature:feature:martial-form.description: At the start of your turn, spend 1 Focus Point to adopt a form for 10 minutes: Forged Heart (Unarmed Strikes crit objects; Flurry hits force a Strength save or push 15 feet), Nightmare Shroud (Deflect Attacks forces a Wisdom save or the attacker is Frightened until the end of its next turn), Traveler's Blade (+10 feet reach), or Weretouched (dropping an adjacent enemy to 0 grants temp HP of a Martial Arts die + Monk level).

feature:feature:mutable-strike.description: Your Unarmed Strikes can deal Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage.

feature:feature:manifest-blow.description: Gain one: Forged Heart (once per turn, +1 Martial Arts die damage), Nightmare Shroud (Magic action, 2 Focus Points: 30-foot Emanation, Wisdom save or 3 Martial Arts dice Psychic and Frightened, half on success), Traveler's Blade (once per turn deal damage and grapple on one hit; you always count as having a free hand to grapple), or Weretouched (hit the same creature twice in a turn to spend up to 3 Focus Points for that many extra Martial Arts dice).

feature:feature:reflexive-adaptation.description: Self-Restoration can also end Blinded, Deafened, and Grappled. A Short Rest removes 1 Exhaustion level, a Long Rest removes all.

feature:feature:perfect-form.description: When adopting your Martial Form, spend 3 more Focus Points to also gain Advantage on Flurry of Blows attacks, regain a Martial Arts die of HP at the start of each turn, and +2 AC while in the form.

feature:feature:demontongue.description: You speak and understand Abyssal or Infernal (your choice).

feature:feature:fiendish-punishment.description: While raging, once per turn when a creature you can see within 60 feet damages you, it takes 1d4 Fire or Necrotic. When an ally within 10 feet is damaged by such a creature, use your Reaction to deal the same. Damage grows to 1d6 (6), 1d8 (10), 1d10 (14), 1d12 (20).

feature:feature:just-one-master.description: While raging, Advantage on saves against Charmed and Frightened and Resistance to Psychic. When you take Psychic damage or save against Charmed or Frightened, you must use your Reaction to Rage without expending a use.

feature:feature:overflowing-malice.description: When a creature triggers Fiendish Punishment, all other creatures within 10 feet of you also take the damage.

feature:feature:aspect-of-tyranny.description: When Fiendish Punishment or Overflowing Malice deals damage, use your Reaction to force one affected creature to make a Wisdom save (DC 8 + Con + PB, -1 per other creature affected that turn): on a failure, 1d10 Necrotic and Frightened for 1 minute (save ends each turn).

feature:feature:bonus-cantrip-2024.description: Learn one Sorcerer cantrip (it counts as a Bard cantrip but not against your known cantrips), and you can use a Wand, Rod, or Orb as your Bard focus.

feature:feature:wandslinger-s-presence.description: After talking with a creature for 1 minute, if it rolls Initiative equal to or higher than yours it makes a Wisdom save; on a failure its Initiative drops to act right after you.

feature:feature:at-your-fingertips.description: Once per round on your turn, when a Bard cantrip hits or a target fails its save, spend a Bardic Inspiration for +2d6 damage (3d6 at 5, 5d6 at 10, 8d6 at 15).

feature:feature:got-your-back.description: When you use At Your Fingertips, use a Bonus Action that turn to give a creature within 60 feet Advantage on its next save within 1 minute.

feature:feature:ain-t-big-enough-for-the.description: Whenever you spend Bardic Inspiration or a creature within 60 feet adds your die to a D20 Test, one creature within 60 feet that can see you makes a Wisdom save or is Frightened until the end of its next turn; an already Frightened target must use its Reaction to flee.

feature:feature:commerce-domain-spells.description: Always prepared: Augury, Charm Person, Comprehend Languages, Locate Object (3); Glyph of Warding, Tongues (5); Divination, Leomund's Secret Chest (7); Legend Lore, Rary's Telepathic Bond (9).

feature:feature:divine-wealth.description: After a Long Rest, conjure 2 divine coins (3 at 5, 4 at 9, 5 at 13, 6 at 17), losing unspent ones. Before a save against a hostile effect, spend a coin to add 1d4, or gain a coin by subtracting 1d4.

feature:feature:money-spinner.description: Magic action and a Channel Divinity: target one creature within 30 feet plus one per coin spent. Each makes a Wisdom save; on a failure, Reward (Charmed and Friendly for 1 minute or until damaged) or Bribe (Blinded for 1 minute or until damaged), your choice per target.

feature:feature:divine-bargain.description: As a Bonus Action with a creature within 30 feet: Buy (give it a coin; it takes 1d8 Necrotic and you or a creature within 30 feet heals that much; it can spend the coin) or Sell (gain a coin; you take unreducible 1d8 Necrotic and it heals that much).

feature:feature:open-market.description: Divine Bargain uses 2d8, and you can bargain with up to six creatures at once using one roll, once per Short Rest.

feature:feature:bloodhound-spells.description: Always prepared: Alarm (3), Hold Person (5), Clairvoyance (9), Locate Creature (13), Scrying (17).

feature:feature:ley-line-tracker.description: After a rest, mark a creature you've seen (or whose possession you hold) as your bounty; once per turn switch it to a creature you can see. Your Ranger Divination spells can target your bounty at any distance on the same plane unless it's warded.

feature:feature:unwavering-attention.description: Once per turn, +1d6 damage when you hit your bounty or your Hunter's Mark target. If dealt with an Opportunity Attack, your Reaction returns at the start of the next creature's turn.

feature:feature:bloodhound:relentless-pu.description: When your bounty or Hunter's Mark target ends its turn more than 5 feet away and you can see it, use your Reaction to move your Speed toward it without provoking.

feature:feature:eyes-on-the-prize.description: When all your Attack-action attacks target one creature, make one extra attack; a melee hit leaves it Grappled or Prone, a ranged hit knocks it Prone.

feature:feature:nowhere-to-hide.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, cast True Seeing on yourself without a slot or components. Ley Line Tracker ignores magic that hides your bounty from Divination.

feature:feature:nemesis-spells.description: Always prepared: Compelled Duel, Mirror Image, See Invisibility, Shield (3); Counterspell, Slow (5); Fire Shield, Otiluke's Resilient Sphere (7); Circle of Power, Mislead (9).

feature:feature:readied-magic.description: When you Ready a spell, you have Advantage on saves and ability checks until your next turn and can cast it without your Reaction. If you don't release it, regain Sorcery Points equal to its level at the start of your next turn.

feature:feature:spell-deflection.description: When a spell or magical effect damages you, use your Reaction to halve that damage.

feature:feature:always-ready.description: Ready a spell as a Bonus Action (it doesn't count toward the one-slot-per-turn limit). Once per Short or Long Rest, or spend 4 Sorcery Points to restore it.

feature:feature:mindset-of-perfect-predi.description: Once per Long Rest when you roll Initiative: your Initiative becomes 31, you can concentrate on any number of spells (one save for all), and you can cast Counterspell as a level 6 spell without a slot. At the end of each of your turns, make a Charisma save (DC 8 + Cha + PB) or the mindset ends, keeping one concentration spell.

feature:feature:eternity-in-stone.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, when you reduce a creature to 0 HP, you can Petrify it and gain 1d10 + Warlock level Temporary Hit Points.

feature:feature:stone-speaker.description: Once per Long Rest as a Magic action, question stones in a 30-foot Emanation about the past day, and speak with earth Elementals or Petrified creatures there.

feature:feature:stone-sovereign-spells.description: Always prepared: Absorb Elements, Earthbind, Earth Tremor, Spike Growth (3); Magic Circle, Slow (5); Stone Shape, Stoneskin (7); Bigby's Hand, Wall of Stone (9).

feature:feature:form-of-stone.description: While Petrified you stay aware and are immune to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing. Once per Short or Long Rest, as a Reaction to damage, Petrify yourself until your next turn (before the damage), then emerge from stone up to 30 feet away.

feature:feature:stone-s-embrace.description: Meld into Stone is always prepared and can include up to five willing creatures within 5 feet. Resting while melded grants Resistance to the first damage after leaving.

feature:feature:stone-servant.description: Touch a Petrified creature to make it an Earth Elemental Spirit under your control as a level 6 Summon Elemental, without Concentration, until Greater Restoration, 0 HP, or you use this again.

feature:feature:ranged-specialist.description: Training with all ranged weapons (including thrown weapons and firearms), and no Disadvantage on ranged attacks for an enemy within 5 feet.

feature:feature:game-hunter.description: After a Long Rest pick Large, Huge, or Gargantuan: ranged hits deal +1d8 Piercing against that size and +1d4 against the other two, up to twice per turn.

feature:feature:bolas.description: After a Long Rest make bolas ammunition equal to your Wisdom modifier (damage optional). A hit forces a Strength or Dexterity save (DC 8 + Wis + PB) or the target is Grappled. Leftovers become normal ammunition.

feature:feature:special-shots.description: Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest, before a ranged attack roll: Drill Shot (+5 to hit), Trick Shot (measure line of sight and range from a point within 60 feet), or Power Shot (weapon damage and crit dice are maximized).

feature:feature:improved-bolas.description: Make bolas equal to Wisdom + Dexterity modifiers, and double your Proficiency Bonus in their DC.

feature:feature:reliable-aim.description: Once per turn, reroll a missed ranged weapon attack, Dexterity modifier times per Long Rest (minimum once).

feature:feature:improved-special-shots.description: Special Shots uses become twice your Proficiency Bonus.

feature:feature:apex-hunter.description: Hunter's Mark lasts 48 hours, and while it's on a living enemy you need no sleep and ignore malnutrition and dehydration.

feature:feature:predator-s-intuition.description: When Bolas or a Special Shot hits a Large or bigger creature, you learn its remaining Hit Points.

feature:feature:finish-the-hunt.description: Once per Long Rest as an Action, with a one-liner, a ranged attack automatically hits a visible Large or bigger creature within 60 feet: it dies if it has 100 HP or fewer, otherwise takes 10d10 + 30 Piercing.

feature:feature:bonesmith:spellcasting.description: Intelligence-based. Cantrips: Poison Spray, Mending, Spare the Dying. Slots usable only for Bonesmith spells (as an Eldritch Knight-style third caster, up to level 4 slots at 19). Always prepared: Inflict Wounds, False Life, Find Familiar (3); Ray of Enfeeblement, Alter Self, Protection from Poison (7); Speak with Dead, Animate Dead, Fear (13); Blight, Fabricate, Death Ward (19). Focus: Smith's or Leatherworker's Tools or a weapon you crafted.

feature:feature:body-knowledge.description: Use Intelligence for attack and damage rolls with weapons you crafted with Melder of Flesh and Bone.

feature:feature:grim-harvest-2024.description: Harvest hide, bone, horn, and fangs from fresh carcasses (more and slower for bigger creatures; two helpers halve the time).

feature:feature:melder-of-flesh-and-bone.description: Proficiency with Leatherworker's Tools, Smith's Tools, and Medicine. Over a Long Rest, craft armor, shields, weapons, and trinkets from harvested parts.

feature:feature:construct-of-flesh.description: Over a Long Rest, build a Medium Undead companion (AC 15, HP 5 + 5 per Fighter level, Str 18, Dex 16) with one trait (Arboreal, Volant, Nocturnal, Robust, or Nimble) and one attack (+4 + PB, 1d10 + PB plus 1d6 Necrotic, with a rider: poison, prone, acid range, or fear). It acts after you and only Dodges unless you spend a Bonus Action to command it.

feature:feature:improved-construct-of-fl.description: Add a second trait, and you can forgo attacks of your Attack action to let the construct attack.

feature:feature:body-modification.description: Over a Long Rest, fuse up to three crafted items (one armor or up to two weapons per rest) into your body; draw or conceal weapons as a Bonus Action.

feature:feature:combat-bonesmithing.description: During the Attack action, spend 10 harvested resources (rising by 10 each use until a Long Rest) to replace one attack with a one-Action Bonesmith spell.

feature:feature:minion-master.description: Construct gets +2 AC, a second attack, and +2d6 Necrotic on its attacks; once per Long Rest it drops to 1 HP instead of 0.

feature:feature:flesh-from-shadow.description: Once per Long Rest cast Creation without a slot, optionally making a harvestable beast carcass up to Large that lasts 24 hours (its products last a week).

feature:feature:circle-of-cycles-spells.description: Always prepared: Augury, Evolution/Devolution (3); Clairvoyance, Tongues, Meld into Stone (5); Legend Lore, Contact Other Plane (9); Find the Path, Contingency, Flesh to Stone, Circle of Death (13); Foresight, Glibness, Time Stop (17).

feature:feature:adaptive-wild-shape.description: Each Wild Shape adds one: +30 climb (or +20), +15 fly (or +10; DM may limit to Tiny and Small until level 8), water breathing and +30 swim (or +20), Darkvision 60 (or +30), or one attack dealing Acid or Poison.

feature:feature:glimpse-future.description: Advantage on Dexterity saves, and use your Reaction to give an ally you can see Advantage on a Dexterity save if they can hear you.

feature:feature:improved-evolution-devol.description: Evolution/Devolution gains 30-foot range and Bonus Action casting; harmful changes also deal 1d8 + Wisdom Necrotic (half on a save). Cast it once per Long Rest at level 2 without a slot.

feature:feature:deep-hibernation.description: Hibernate for 24+ hours without aging or needs, waking with a Long Rest and a chosen apparent age; commune with the past or a possible future for lore.

feature:feature:improved-glimpse-future.description: Evasion on Dexterity saves, and use your Reaction to grant it to an ally who can hear you.

feature:feature:cosmological-evolution.description: Once per Long Rest as an Action: darkness or daylight over 10 miles for 10 minutes, or for 1 minute you and allies within 15 feet reroll one missed melee attack, missed ranged attack, or failed save per turn (your pick).

feature:feature:guided-evolution.description: Concentrate on Evolution/Devolution for 10 minutes to make it last until recast or the target's next Long Rest.

feature:feature:future-sight.description: Once per Long Rest as an Action, for 1 hour you have Advantage on attacks and attacks against you have Disadvantage (not while Incapacitated or Blinded).

feature:feature:equipped-for-battle.description: You become trained with Heavy armor.

feature:feature:close-quarters.description: After you hit a creature with a Melee weapon attack roll, you can take a Reaction to add 2d6 damage of the weapon's type; the target then has Disadvantage on its next attack roll made before the start of your next turn. The extra damage rises to 4d6 at Monster Hunter level 11.

feature:feature:carver-guild:true-grit.description: Saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition have Advantage, and creature types in your Monster Grimoire can't give you the Frightened condition at all. Also, whenever an attack you make as part of a Reaction hits, you can end the Frightened condition on yourself or on one creature within 60 feet that can see you.
