actions.description: Two Bite attacks against different targets.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +4, reach 5 ft.; 10 (4d4) Piercing, or 5 (2d4) while Bloodied. A creature with teeth makes a DC 12 Constitution save or loses a tooth, which the swarm implants in one of its mouths; a creature that already lost a tooth this way succeeds automatically.

traits.name: Coven Magic
traits.description: Within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, it can cast Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Lucky Charm (lasting until it casts it again or ends it), or Unseen Servant, each once per Long Rest, without Material components, using Intelligence.

traits.name: Scoured Filth
traits.description: Soapy water burns it: a splashed bucket or flask counts as a vial of Acid, and full immersion at the start of its turn deals 20 Acid.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: Can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Bite attacks or Spellcasting to cast Contagion, and it can also use Warping Caress.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +9, reach 5 ft.; 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic and Poisoned until the start of the hag's next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: Charisma, save DC 17, no Material components. At will: Contagion, Disguise Self (24-hour duration), Hold Person, Invisibility (self only). 1/day each: Insect Plague (level 8), Polymorph.

actions.name: Warping Caress
actions.description: Constitution save DC 17, one creature within 5 feet: 19 (4d6 + 5) Necrotic and 1 Exhaustion level, its warped body having Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks and saves until its Exhaustion is 0; half damage only on success. A Humanoid killed this way can, with 2 days of work, become a Deepdreck, or a Fleshdobbin if combined with a horse corpse.

traits.name: Husk Body
traits.description: Moves through a 1-inch gap at no extra cost.

traits.name: Uneasy Visage
traits.description: While a creature holds it, creatures within 10 feet have Disadvantage on Insight checks against its bonded creature.

actions.name: Husk Cut
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 1 Slashing plus 4 (1d8) Psychic.

actions.name: Blank Stare
actions.description: Wisdom save DC 13, one creature it can see within 30 feet: 10 (3d6) Psychic, half on success.

actions.name: Sowing Dread (2/Day)
actions.description: Wisdom save DC 13, each creature of its choice in a 15-foot Cone: Frightened until the end of its next turn on failure.

reactions.name: Silent Protector (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
reactions.description: When a creature within 60 feet fails a save against an effect that deals no damage, the dolly suffers the effect instead.

traits.name: Ashen Forbiddance
traits.description: Can't cross a line of ash from burned feathers sprinkled with Holy Water.

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.description: If it dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves and it revives with full Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

traits.name: Devour Anima
traits.description: A creature it reduces to 0 Hit Points is cursed until it regains Hit Points; while cursed, failing a Death Saving Throw at the start of its turn kills it outright.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.description: Mimics any voice it has heard or one known to a creature within its telepathy; a DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check reveals the imitation.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Feeding Frenzy if available, then one Beak and one Claws attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing plus 7 (2d6) Psychic.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 8 (2d4 + 3) Slashing, and a Medium or smaller target is knocked Prone.

actions.name: Feeding Frenzy (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Until the start of its next turn, its Speed doubles and it gains Temporary Hit Points equal to half the damage it deals.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: Can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weakness
traits.description: Self-Loathing: Disadvantage on D20 Tests while it can see its reflection. Sunlight Hypersensitivity: takes 20 Radiant if it starts its turn in sunlight, and has Disadvantage on attacks and ability checks there.

actions.name: Consume
actions.description: Melee or ranged attack, +5, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft.; 10 (2d6 + 3) Necrotic, the target's Hit Point maximum drops by that much, and it regains that many Hit Points.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: Wisdom, save DC 13, no Material components. At will: Disguise Self, Thaumaturgy.

bonusActions.name: Crimson Blessing (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: Casts Bless with its Spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Crooked Thorns
traits.description: At the start of each of its turns, it deals 5 (1d10) Psychic to each creature grappling it or grappled by it.

traits.name: Old Bindings
traits.description: An attack roll that hits it using Smith's Tools or Tinker's Tools (as a Club or Light Hammer) deals an extra 10 Force.

actions.name: Impale
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing, and a Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 13) by one of two branch arms and Restrained while grappled.

traits.name: Trackless Step
traits.description: Leaves no tracks, or the tracks of a Large or smaller creature of its choice, and unless Incapacitated can share this with a creature within 5 feet.

actions.name: Twisting Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing plus 7 (2d6) Poison, and a creature makes a DC 11 Charisma save or is cursed for 24 hours, its limbs twisting unnaturally and giving it Disadvantage on attack rolls and Charisma checks.

traits.name: Aversion to Self-Sacrifice
traits.description: He takes 20 Necrotic whenever he sees a creature willingly take damage or a condition in another's place or for another's benefit.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Crooked Claw attacks, replacing one with Snap Limb if he likes, and Confusion if available.

actions.name: Crooked Claw
actions.description: Melee attack, +11, reach 5 ft.; 15 (2d8 + 6) Slashing plus 21 (6d6) Psychic, and a Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 16) by one of two claws and Restrained while grappled.

actions.name: Snap Limb
actions.description: Constitution save DC 19, one creature he grapples that has breakable limbs: 35 (10d6) Force and a broken limb of his choice, half damage only on success. Broken Arm: Disadvantage on attacks and can't hold or manipulate with it. Broken Leg: Speed halved, and Dashing requires a DC 15 Dexterity save or it falls Prone. Broken Wing: Fly Speed 0. A broken limb heals in 40 days or when the creature regains Hit Points from magic or Regeneration.

actions.name: Confusion (1/Day)
actions.description: Casts Confusion without Material components, using Charisma (save DC 17).

bonusActions.name: Blinking Teleport
bonusActions.description: He turns Invisible for 1 minute and teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet; the invisibility ends right after he deals damage.

monster:crowstorm.conditionImmunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: False Crows
traits.description: Can't enter a space holding a drawn or painted crow or a crow effigy, and a creature holding such an icon has Advantage on saves the swarm forces.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: Can share another creature's space and move through openings large enough for a Tiny crow; it can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Wing Bind
traits.description: A non-Fiend creature with a Fly Speed that starts its turn in its 30-foot Emanation makes a DC 13 Wisdom save or has Fly Speed 0 until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Peck
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing, or 7 (1d8 + 3) while Bloodied, and a creature has Disadvantage on attacks until the start of the swarm's next turn.

actions.name: Cacophony (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Wisdom save DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation: 10 (3d6) Psychic and Frightened until the start of the swarm's next turn, half damage only on success.

monster:deepdreck.senses: darkvision 120 ft., tremorsense 120 ft.; passive Perception 13

traits.name: Explosive Death
traits.description: When it dies, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation makes a DC 14 Dexterity save, taking 13 (3d8) Poison or half on success.

traits.name: Fragrance Aversion
traits.description: Disadvantage on attacks and saves while within 10 feet of burning incense or a creature wearing Perfume.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.description: Burrows through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed, leaving a 5-foot-diameter tunnel.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two attacks using Claw or Putrid Emission in any combination.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee attack, +6, reach 5 ft.; 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing plus 7 (2d6) Poison.

actions.name: Putrid Emission
actions.description: Ranged attack, +6, range 60 ft.; 8 (1d8 + 4) Poison and Poisoned until the start of the deepdreck's next turn.

traits.name: Scent of Death
traits.description: Creatures that can smell have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to find it.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: Can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.

actions.name: Tendril
actions.description: Melee attack, +4, reach 5 ft.; 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic, and it attaches, unable to use Tendril on others; a creature that can smell it is Poisoned until the start of its next turn. It detaches with 5 feet of movement, or the target or a creature within 5 feet can remove it as an action.

actions.name: Decaying Bloom (2/Day)
actions.description: Constitution save DC 12, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation: 9 (2d8) Necrotic and no healing until the start of its next turn, half damage only on success.

bonusActions.name: Symbiosis
bonusActions.description: Bonds with a willing creature it touches, which then needs no food or drink and has Advantage on saves to avoid or end Poisoned, until either dies, the glove ends it, or it bonds again.

traits.name: Boil and Bubble
traits.description: Unless Incapacitated, it can heat water in its vessel to boiling.

actions.name: Steam Spray
actions.description: Ranged attack, +4, range 60 ft.; 7 (2d4 + 2) Fire (not resisted for being underwater), and the target has Disadvantage on its next attack before the dingpot's next turn.

actions.name: Brew (1/Day)
actions.description: Brews an elixir that stays potent for 24 hours, drunk as a Bonus Action: Healing Draught (regain 4 (1d6 + 1) Hit Points) or Lucky Draught (for 10 minutes, reroll a failed ability check or save and use the new roll, ending once a reroll succeeds).

traits.name: Irresistible Payment
traits.description: A creature that offers it alcohol or any gold as an Influence action and succeeds on a DC 16 Charisma (Persuasion) check forces it to accept and use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed away by the safest route.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee attack, +9, reach 5 ft.; 12 (2d6 + 5) Piercing plus 11 (2d10) Psychic.

actions.name: Terrifying Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Wisdom save DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone: 14 (4d6) Psychic, drops what it holds, and is Frightened, Dashing away by the safest route each turn, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns and succeeding automatically after 1 minute; half damage only on success.

bonusActions.name: Call the Hounds
bonusActions.description: Summons three hounds (Wolf stat block) within 60 feet that act right after it and obey its mental commands, vanishing when they or it drop to 0 Hit Points or it uses this again.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Moth Ward
traits.description: A creature holding a moth's wing automatically succeeds on saves against Hypnotic Wings.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: Can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Talons attacks, and it can use Devour Dreams.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Melee attack, +8, reach 5 ft.; 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing, and a Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 14) by one of two talons and Restrained while grappled.

actions.name: Devour Dreams
actions.description: Charisma save DC 16, a creature it grapples or an Incapacitated creature within 5 feet (which fails automatically): 18 (4d8) Psychic and Charisma reduced by 1d6, half damage only on success. A creature reduced to 0 Charisma doesn't recover it on a Long Rest and is Incapacitated until Greater Restoration, Heal, or Wish restores its mind.

bonusActions.name: Hypnotic Wings
bonusActions.description: Its wings shed Bright Light in a 30-foot Emanation and Dim Light 30 feet beyond until its next turn; each creature in the Bright Light makes a DC 16 Wisdom save or is Incapacitated with Speed 0 until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Coffin Boat
traits.description: It rides an open coffin on swamp water at Speed 40 over any surface, liquids included, ignoring Difficult Terrain, carrying two more Medium creatures (two Small or four Tiny count as one Medium). While riding it, it can't be knocked Prone. The coffin has AC 15, 25 Hit Points, and immunity to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic; a destroyed coffin can be remade in a 10-minute ritual.

traits.name: Payment
traits.description: A creature that offers it 3 CP as an Influence action must be offered a peaceful ride (once space frees up), and any curse the ferryman placed on it ends. This ends, and can't be used with this ferryman again, if the creature or its allies damage the ferryman or force it to save.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: Regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Lantern Pole attacks, and Hexed Lantern if available.

actions.name: Lantern Pole
actions.description: Melee attack, +7, reach 10 ft.; 9 (1d10 + 4) Bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic, and a Medium or smaller target is knocked Prone.

actions.name: Hexed Lantern (1/Day)
actions.description: Wisdom save DC 13, each creature of its choice in a 30-foot Cone: cursed for 1 minute on failure, subtracting 1d4 from D20 Tests.

monster:festerhulk.languages: understands Common and Giant but can't speak

traits.name: Fungal Step
traits.description: Ignores Difficult Terrain caused by plants or fungi.

traits.name: Spore Cloud
traits.description: At the end of each of its turns, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation takes 10 (3d6) Necrotic and is Poisoned until the end of its next turn. A Giant killed this way rises 24 hours later as a Festerhulk, a Humanoid as a Zombie.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.description: Takes 10 Radiant if it starts its turn in sunlight, and has Disadvantage on attacks and ability checks there.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Fetid Slam attacks, and Slime Mold if available.

actions.name: Fetid Slam
actions.description: Melee attack, +11, reach 10 ft.; 20 (2d12 + 7) Bludgeoning plus 13 (3d8) Necrotic.

actions.name: Slime Mold (1/Day)
actions.description: Disgorges a Medium Plant version of a Black Pudding within 20 feet that acts on its Initiative; it and any masses it splits into die after 1 hour.

traits.name: Bridle Binding
traits.description: A creature that bridles it (as securing Manacles) leaves it Charmed while bridled, and it can't remove the bridle itself.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: It can't shape-shift.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: One Claw and one Wailing Halberd attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee attack, +8, reach 10 ft.; 8 (1d6 + 5) Piercing, and a Large or smaller target is knocked Prone.

actions.name: Wailing Halberd
actions.description: Melee attack, +8, reach 15 ft.; 10 (1d10 + 5) Slashing plus 5 (1d10) Psychic.

actions.name: Shriek (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Wisdom save DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone: 28 (8d6) Psychic and Frightened, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns and succeeding automatically after 1 minute; half damage only on success.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: Adds 3 to its AC against a melee attack from a creature it can see while wielding a melee weapon, possibly causing a miss.

traits.name: Ephemeral Body
traits.description: Moves through a 1-inch gap at no extra cost.

traits.name: Seer's Strand
traits.description: It can see and hear from the space of any of its Ether Webs.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: Can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.description: Ignores movement restrictions from webs and knows the location of any creature touching the same web.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing, and a creature is Poisoned until the start of the crawler's next turn.

actions.name: Ether Webs (2/Day)
actions.description: Fills a 5-foot Cube with Invisible webs for 8 hours (they vanish unless anchored between two solid masses or layered on a surface). It knows the location of any creature that touches them while on the same plane.

traits.name: Blighted Aura
traits.description: Ground in its 20-foot Emanation is Difficult Terrain from fungal growth; a creature that ends its turn there takes 5 (1d10) Necrotic.

traits.name: Carved Past
traits.description: A creature that uses an action and a Dagger or Woodcarver's Tools to carve the Sylvan name of the gloomwoods' ancient home into its trunk stops it using Fungal Fling and Spore Stomp until it finishes a Long Rest.

traits.name: Fungal Step
traits.description: Ignores Difficult Terrain caused by plants or fungi.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two attacks using Slam or Fungal Fling in any combination.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee attack, +10, reach 10 ft.; 13 (2d6 + 6) Bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic, and a Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 16) by one of two branches and Restrained while grappled.

actions.name: Fungal Fling
actions.description: Ranged attack, +10, range 60/180 ft.; 23 (5d6 + 6) Bludgeoning plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic.

actions.name: Spore Stomp (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Melee attack, +10, reach 5 ft.; 17 (2d10 + 6) Bludgeoning. Hit or miss, each creature in a 20-foot Sphere centered on the target makes a DC 15 Constitution save: 36 (8d8) Poison and Poisoned until the end of its next turn, half damage only on success.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: Advantage on attacks against a creature that has a non-Incapacitated ally of the goatstealer within 5 feet of it.

traits.name: Stench
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn in its 5-foot Emanation makes a DC 12 Constitution save or is Poisoned until the start of its next turn; on success it is immune to all goatstealers' stench for 1 hour.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +4, reach 5 ft.; 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing plus 3 (1d6) Poison, and a Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 12), taking 3 (1d6) Poison at the start of each of the goatstealer's turns while grappled.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Repelled by Stars
traits.description: Can't willingly move within 10 feet of a seven-pointed star drawn on a surface or woven from wicker.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Beak attacks; it can replace one with Talons.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee attack, +8, reach 5 ft.; 9 (1d8 + 5) Piercing plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic, the target's Hit Point maximum drops by the Necrotic damage, and it regains that many Hit Points.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Melee attack, +8, reach 5 ft.; 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing, and a Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 15) by both talons and Restrained while grappled.

actions.name: Eye Beam
actions.description: Dexterity save DC 14, each creature in a 120-foot by 5-foot Line: 6 (1d12) Psychic and Stunned until the start of its next turn on failure.

traits.name: Blood Sense
traits.description: Knows the location of any Bloodied creature within 60 feet that isn't a Construct or Undead.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic, and it attaches, its Claw attacks then hitting that target automatically. It detaches with 5 feet of movement, or the target or a creature within 5 feet can remove it as an action.

actions.name: Exsanguinate (1/Day)
actions.description: Constitution save DC 13, each creature of its choice in a 15-foot Emanation: 10 (3d6) Necrotic and no healing until the start of its next turn, half damage only on success; it regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt to the creature it is attached to.

traits.name: Endless Footwork
traits.description: While its Speed is 0, attacks against it have Advantage, and if its Speed is 0 at the start of its turn it takes 20 Necrotic.

traits.name: Perfect Grace
traits.description: Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it leaves an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Three Banner Pole attacks; it can replace one with Lethal Jape.

actions.name: Banner Pole
actions.description: Melee attack, +10 (Advantage if the target's Speed is 0), reach 10 ft.; 11 (1d10 + 6) Slashing plus 13 (3d8) Thunder, and it can move a Large or smaller target to another unoccupied space within reach.

actions.name: Lethal Jape
actions.description: Wisdom save DC 15, one creature it can see within 60 feet: 24 (7d6) Psychic and Speed 0 until the end of its next turn, half damage only on success.

reactions.name: Wave the Banner
reactions.description: When an ally within 60 feet misses an attack or fails a save, the ally can reroll the d20 and must use the new roll.

monster:hospital-horror.languages: understands Common and Deep Speech but can't speak

traits.name: Aversion to Needles
traits.description: After taking Piercing damage, it has Disadvantage on attacks until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: Advantage on attacks against a creature that has a non-Incapacitated ally of the horror within 5 feet of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Graft Blade attacks.

actions.name: Graft Blade
actions.description: Melee attack, +6, reach 5 ft.; 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing.

bonusActions.name: Stim Burst
bonusActions.description: Takes the Dash action and can jump up to 30 feet for 10 feet of movement.

monster:house-of-horror.languages: understands Common and one other language but can't speak
monster:house-of-horror.conditionImmunities: exhaustion, grappled, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Construction
traits.description: Creatures can enter and move through it like a normal building. It attacks from any unworn, uncarried surface or object in its space and has no Disadvantage on ranged attacks for nearby enemies. If a creature deals 30 or more damage in one turn to a 5-foot section, it makes a DC 18 Constitution save or that section opens until the start of the creature's next turn.

traits.name: Exorcism Susceptibility
traits.description: Dispel Evil and Good targeting it leaves it Stunned, resaving with a DC 15 Charisma save at the end of each of its turns and succeeding automatically after 1 minute. A creature inside that throws Holy Water against it as a Magic action and succeeds on a DC 20 Charisma check has the same effect.

traits.name: Soul Trap
traits.description: A Humanoid that dies inside it has its soul trapped until the house dies, and can be revived only by True Resurrection or Wish.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Three attacks using Structure Slam or Object Fling in any combination, and it uses Agonized Souls.

actions.name: Structure Slam
actions.description: Melee attack, +11, reach 5 ft.; 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning plus 9 (2d8) Force, and a Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 16) by animated furniture or fixtures; up to two at once.

actions.name: Object Fling
actions.description: Ranged attack, +11, range 20/60 ft.; 11 (2d4 + 6) Bludgeoning or Piercing (its choice), and a Large or smaller target is knocked Prone.

actions.name: Agonized Souls
actions.description: Wisdom save DC 16, one creature within 10 feet: 36 (8d8) Necrotic, half on success.

bonusActions.name: Alter Structure
bonusActions.description: Rearranges its walls, doors, floors, and other features; a creature within 5 feet of a changing feature can make a DC 18 Dexterity save to choose its side or move to the nearest space to avoid falling.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: One Bite and one Claw attack, and it can use Swallow.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +12, reach 5 ft.; 18 (2d10 + 7) Piercing plus 7 (2d6) Psychic, and a Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 17) and Restrained while grappled.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee attack, +12, reach 5 ft.; 14 (2d6 + 7) Piercing plus 7 (2d6) Psychic, and a Large or smaller target is knocked Prone.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: Strength save DC 20, one Medium or smaller creature it grapples (one swallowed at a time): on failure it is swallowed, Blinded, Restrained, with Total Cover from outside, taking 21 (6d6) Psychic at the start of each of its turns; if this kills it, the hypnovulfen absorbs its memories and regains 25 Hit Points. If it takes 30 or more damage in one turn from the swallowed creature, it makes a DC 16 Constitution save at the end of that turn or regurgitates it Prone within 10 feet. If it dies, the creature can escape using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

bonusActions.name: Hypnotic Gaze (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.description: Wisdom save DC 19, each creature in a 30-foot Cone (automatic success for one holding a loved one's keepsake): Charmed until it takes damage, Incapacitated and moving as close to the hypnovulfen as possible by the safest route, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns and succeeding automatically after 1 minute.

traits.name: Alien Mind
traits.description: A creature that tries to read its mind or deals Psychic damage to it makes a DC 16 Intelligence save or is Stunned for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

traits.name: Gliding Levitation
traits.description: It hovers 6 inches up, leaves no tracks, ignores ground-based Difficult Terrain, moves over liquids, and takes no falling damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Weak Constitution
traits.description: Disadvantage on saves to avoid or end Poisoned, and it takes 20 Necrotic if it starts its turn Poisoned.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Three Disrupting Touch attacks, and Unnerving Glare if available.

actions.name: Disrupting Touch
actions.description: Melee attack, +8, reach 5 ft.; 15 (2d10 + 4) Force. A creature killed or object destroyed by it crumbles to gray dust (magic items and a victim's gear survive).

actions.name: Unnerving Glare (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Wisdom save DC 16, one creature it can see within 60 feet: Incapacitated until the start of the invader's next turn on failure.

reactions.name: Otherworldly Slip
reactions.description: When it takes damage, it teleports to a space it can see within 60 feet, and each creature in a 30-foot Emanation from its departure or arrival point (its choice) makes a DC 16 Intelligence save: 16 (3d10) Psychic and Speed halved until the end of its next turn, half damage only on success.

monster:kackle.damageResistances: Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Piercing, Slashing, Thunder
monster:kackle.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: Moves through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain, taking 5 (1d10) Force if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Lantern Vulnerability
traits.description: Its lantern has AC 15 and immunity to Poison and Psychic; damage to the lantern deals half as much Force damage to the kackle.

actions.name: Lantern Flame
actions.description: Melee or ranged attack, +7, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft.; effect by lantern color (its choice): Blue, 7 (1d6 + 4) Cold and Restrained until the end of the target's next turn; Green, 20 (3d10 + 4) Necrotic and Speed 0 until the end of its next turn; Purple, 10 (1d12 + 4) Psychic and Frightened until the end of its next turn; Red, 15 (2d10 + 4) Fire and the target burns, taking 5 (1d10) Fire instead of normal burning damage.

bonusActions.name: Flickering Teleport
bonusActions.description: Teleports up to 60 feet to a space it can see and can change its lantern color; each creature in a 5-foot Emanation where it arrives makes a DC 15 Dexterity save, taking 13 (3d8) damage of the current color's type, half on success.

traits.name: Blight Dependent
traits.description: When targeted by an effect that ends the Poisoned condition, it takes 10 (3d6) Force and has Disadvantage on D20 Tests until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Fungal Step
traits.description: Ignores Difficult Terrain caused by plants or fungi.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two attacks using Blight Staff or Spore Spray in any combination, and it uses Rotting Ritual.

actions.name: Blight Staff
actions.description: Melee attack, +8, reach 5 ft.; 9 (1d8 + 5) Bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic.

actions.name: Spore Spray
actions.description: Ranged attack, +8, range 60 ft.; 9 (2d8) Poison, and a creature is Poisoned until the end of the keeper's next turn.

actions.name: Rotting Ritual
actions.description: One effect, never the same twice in a row: Frenzying Spores (DC 16 Wisdom save, one creature it can see within 30 feet: 10 (3d6) Psychic and it must use its Reaction to attack a creature of the keeper's choice in reach or range; half damage only on success); Blight Spawn (summons an obedient Rotweaver without a Hunting Horn within 30 feet, acting right after it, for 1 minute or until either dies); Devouring Fungus (a 60-foot radius around it becomes Difficult Terrain and Poisons creatures within, for 1 minute, until it uses this again, or until it dies).

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: Wisdom, save DC 16, +8 to hit, no Material components. At will: Druidcraft, Ray of Sickness. 1/day: Blight.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.description: Mimics any voice it has heard or stolen; a DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check reveals the imitation, or DC 19 for a stolen voice.

traits.name: Riddle Bound
traits.description: A creature that poses it a riddle as an Influence action and succeeds on a DC 16 Charisma (Deception) check leaves it Incapacitated until the start of that creature's next turn; each riddle raises the DC by 1 for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Claw attacks; it can replace one with Consume Voice.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee attack, +6, reach 5 ft.; 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing plus 7 (2d6) Psychic, and a creature has Disadvantage on the next save the ketgrinn forces before the end of the ketgrinn's next turn.

actions.name: Consume Voice
actions.description: Charisma save DC 14, one creature within 5 feet: 18 (4d8) Psychic and its voice is stolen, leaving it unable to make any vocal sound, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns; after three failures the loss lasts until the ketgrinn dies. Half damage only on success.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.description: Casts Invisibility on itself without components, using Charisma.

bonusActions.name: Teleport
bonusActions.description: Teleports up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

traits.name: Depicted Demise
traits.description: It takes 20 Force at the start of its turn if it can see a creature holding a drawing, painting, carving, or other depiction of it.

traits.name: Silt Stealth
traits.description: Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks among aquatic plants or seaweed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: One Bite and one Tail attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +10, reach 10 ft.; 15 (2d8 + 6) Piercing plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic, and a Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 16) and Restrained while grappled.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee attack, +10, reach 15 ft.; 24 (4d8 + 6) Bludgeoning, and a Huge or smaller target is knocked Prone.

bonusActions.name: Swallow
bonusActions.description: Dexterity save DC 18, one Large or smaller creature it grapples (one at a time): on failure it is swallowed, Restrained, with Three-Quarters Cover from outside, taking 21 (6d6) Necrotic at the start of each of its turns. It can use an action to escape through the ribcage, taking 11 (2d10) Piercing and emerging within 5 feet. If the dredger dies, it can escape using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

traits.name: Nightmarish Contortion
traits.description: Fits in a 1-foot Cube and moves through a 1-inch gap at no extra cost.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: Can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.

traits.name: Ward of Innocence
traits.description: Can't attack or willingly move within 10 feet of a creature holding a stuffed animal once owned by a child.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee attack, +6, reach 10 ft.; 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing, and a Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 14) by one of two claws and Restrained while grappled.

bonusActions.name: Dark Teleport
bonusActions.description: While not in Bright Light, it teleports up to 120 feet to a space it can see (or any space not in Bright Light); a creature it grapples makes a DC 13 Charisma save or comes along to the nearest open space.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Beak attacks.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing plus 3 (1d6) Radiant.

bonusActions.name: Bonded Voice
bonusActions.description: Forms or dissolves a bond with a willing creature within 5 feet, which can then speak through the magpie in its own voice with a birdlike lilt, until it dies or the magpie bonds anew.

reactions.name: One for Sorrow (1/Day)
reactions.description: When a creature within 30 feet makes a D20 Test with Advantage, it subtracts 1d6 from the total.

reactions.name: Two for Joy (2/Day)
reactions.description: When it or another creature within 30 feet makes an ability check or save, that creature adds 1d4.

traits.name: Undoing Gift (1/Day)
traits.description: It must accept and eat an apple offered to it or its lure, then takes 55 (10d10) Poison and is Poisoned for 1 minute.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Tendril attacks; it can replace one with Chew.

actions.name: Tendril
actions.description: Melee attack, +10, reach 10 ft.; 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning, and a Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 16) by one of two tendrils and Restrained while grappled.

actions.name: Chew
actions.description: Melee attack, +10, reach 5 ft.; 11 (1d10 + 6) Piercing, plus 18 (4d8) Piercing against a Restrained target.

bonusActions.name: Lure
bonusActions.description: Shapes its lure into a Small or Medium Humanoid (or retracts it), speaking through it and moving it within tendril reach; one creature within 30 feet of the lure makes a DC 15 Intelligence save or is Charmed until the start of its next turn, approaching the lure as closely as it can, with the maidenwood having Advantage against it. Damage ends the charm at the end of the current turn.

reactions.name: Absorb Magic
reactions.description: When it succeeds on a save against a spell or magical effect or a spell attack misses it, it gains 10 Temporary Hit Points.

monster:moonshine.damageResistances: Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Piercing, Slashing, Thunder
monster:moonshine.conditionImmunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Detect Life
traits.description: Senses the direction of creatures within 60 feet that aren't Constructs or Undead.

traits.name: Ephemeral
traits.description: Can't wear or carry anything.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.description: Sheds Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for 15 feet beyond.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: Moves through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain, taking 5 (1d10) Force if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Gloomy Touch attacks.

actions.name: Gloomy Touch
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 7 (1d8 + 3) Psychic.

actions.name: Siphon Life (2/Day)
actions.description: Constitution save DC 11, one creature it can see within 5 feet that isn't a Construct or Undead: on failure it is Stunned until the end of the moonshine's next turn, and the moonshine or a creature of its choice within 30 feet regains 3 (1d6) Hit Points.

traits.name: Anchoring Mask
traits.description: It wears a porcelain mask (AC 15, 15 Hit Points, immune to Poison and Psychic). If it starts its turn unmasked, it must move to retrieve the mask if it can, or else to the nearest creature it perceives and attack it; with no creature in sight or hearing, it either stands idle or wrecks nearby objects (even chance).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Stab attacks; after a Stab hit it can use Inject if available.

actions.name: Stab
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing plus 3 (1d6) Poison.

actions.name: Inject (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Constitution save DC 13, a creature it hit with Stab this turn: 10 (3d6) Psychic and Poisoned for 1 hour, and also Unconscious until damaged or shaken awake on a failure by 5 or more; half damage only on success.

actions.name: Mutation
actions.description: It has one: Cerebral Graft (DC 13 Intelligence save, one creature within 30 feet: 11 (2d10) Psychic and Stunned until the end of its next turn, half damage only on success) or Tentacle Lash (DC 13 Dexterity save, each creature in a 30-foot Cone: 10 (3d6) Bludgeoning and Prone, half damage only on success).

bonusActions.name: Catalyst (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
bonusActions.description: Until the start of its next turn, its Speed doubles, its Multiattack includes one extra Stab, and it gains +2 AC.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Psychic Strike
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 9 (1d12 + 3) Psychic, and a creature is Frightened until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.description: Casts Invisibility on itself without components, using Intelligence, and once per Long Rest can extend it to a creature it is touching, ending early if either breaks it or contact ends.

monster:necrolisk.senses: blindsight 60 ft., tremorsense 120 ft.; passive Perception 15

traits.name: Entrapping Saliva
traits.description: It ignores incorporeal creatures' immunity to Grappled and Restrained; swallowed creatures can't leave through Incorporeal Movement, the Ethereal Plane, or teleportation.

traits.name: Herb Allergy
traits.description: If it ingests a specific 25 GP herb concoction (such as one poured in by a swallowed creature as a Utilize action), it regurgitates everything at the end of the turn as if it failed its Swallow save.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: Can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.description: Burrows through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed, leaving a 10-foot-diameter tunnel.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: One Bite and one Claws attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +10, reach 15 ft.; 15 (2d8 + 6) Piercing plus 3 (1d6) Force, and a Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 16) and Restrained while grappled.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee attack, +10, reach 10 ft.; 9 (1d6 + 6) Slashing plus 4 (1d8) Force.

actions.name: Ephemeral Spit (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Dexterity save DC 16, each creature in a 60-foot by 5-foot Line: 42 (12d6) Force and Restrained until the end of its next turn, half damage only on success.

bonusActions.name: Swallow
bonusActions.description: Dexterity save DC 18, one Large or smaller creature it grapples (one at a time): on failure it is swallowed, Blinded, Restrained, with Total Cover from outside, taking 21 (6d6) Force at the start of each of its turns. If it takes 30 or more damage in one turn from the swallowed creature, it makes a DC 14 Constitution save at the end of that turn or regurgitates it Prone within 10 feet. If it dies, the creature can escape using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

traits.name: Blood Stalker
traits.description: Advantage on Wisdom checks to find or track a creature missing any Hit Points.

traits.name: Salt Susceptibility
traits.description: Vulnerable to damage from weapons wiped with salt; a creature can salt a weapon as a Bonus Action, lasting 1 minute or until it hits.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: Can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.description: Takes 20 Radiant if it starts its turn in sunlight, and has Disadvantage on attacks and ability checks there.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: One Claw attack, and it uses Bite.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee attack, +6, reach 5 ft.; 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing, and a Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 14) by one of two claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Constitution save DC 14, one creature within 5 feet that is willing, Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained: 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic, the target's Hit Point maximum drops by the Necrotic damage, and it regains that many Hit Points.

bonusActions.name: Shape-Shift
bonusActions.description: Out of sunlight, it shifts into a Medium Humanoid or back, keeping its statistics except size; gear doesn't change.

traits.name: Animal Mask
traits.description: A creature grappling it can remove its animal mask as an action, or as an attack during the Attack action, with a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check. Unmasked, it can't cast spells, loses Concentration, and its Songs of the Old Ways DC drops by 4.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Three Ritual Dagger attacks.

actions.name: Ritual Dagger
actions.description: Melee or ranged attack, +7, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft.; 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing plus 7 (2d6) Radiant or Necrotic (its choice).

actions.name: Songs of the Old Ways (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One song: Blessing of the Harvest (creatures of its choice in a 30-foot Emanation regain 14 (4d4 + 4) Hit Points); Song of Sacrifice (DC 14 Constitution save, one creature within 30 feet: 40 (9d8) Necrotic and Paralyzed until the end of its next turn, half damage only on success); Wicker Chant (DC 14 Dexterity save, creatures of its choice in a 20-foot Emanation: 31 (9d6) Fire, half on success).

actions.name: Spellcasting (Requires Animal Mask)
actions.description: Wisdom, save DC 15, +7 to hit, no Material components besides the mask. At will: Druidcraft, Minor Illusion. 2/day each: Entangle, Scorching Ray (level 4).

bonusActions.name: Jump (Requires Animal Mask)
bonusActions.description: Casts Jump with its Spellcasting.

monster:phantom-hearse.damageResistances: Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Piercing, Slashing, Thunder
monster:phantom-hearse.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Breathless Warding
traits.description: A creature holding its breath is Invisible to it; if it takes damage meanwhile, it makes a DC 15 Constitution save or exhales and becomes visible to the hearse until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: Moves through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain, taking 5 (1d10) Force if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Ghostly Coachman attacks; it can replace one with Trample if available.

actions.name: Ghostly Coachman
actions.description: Melee or ranged attack, +8, reach 10 ft. or range 60 ft.; 13 (2d8 + 4) Cold, and a creature can't regain Hit Points until the start of the hearse's next turn.

actions.name: Trample (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Moves up to its Speed in a straight line; each creature whose space it enters makes a DC 16 Dexterity save: 10 (3d6) Cold, and a Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 14) and Restrained while grappled; half damage only on success.

actions.name: Tolling Bell (1/Day)
actions.description: Wisdom save DC 16, each creature of its choice it can see in a 30-foot Emanation: 44 (8d10) Psychic and Speed halved until the start of the hearse's next turn, half damage only on success.

bonusActions.name: Entomb
bonusActions.description: Strength save DC 16, one creature it grapples (up to three entombed): on failure it is sealed in a coffin, no longer grappled but Blinded, Restrained, with Total Cover from outside, taking 21 (6d6) Necrotic and an Exhaustion level at the start of each of the hearse's turns. If the hearse takes 20 or more damage in one turn from inside a coffin, it makes a DC 12 Constitution save at the end of that turn or releases all of them Prone within 5 feet; if it dies, they drop Prone in its space.

traits.name: Coven Magic
traits.description: Within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, it can cast Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Lucky Charm (lasting until it casts it again or ends it), or Unseen Servant, each once per Long Rest, without Material components, using Intelligence.

traits.name: Disarming Vanity
traits.description: A creature that flatters it as an Influence action forces a DC 17 Charisma save; on failure it is Incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Harrying Wings
traits.description: When it rolls Initiative, angry fey pigeons surround it; enemies in its 10-foot Emanation have Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls, unless it is Incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Three Claw attacks; it can replace one with an at-will Spellcasting spell.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee attack, +10, reach 5 ft.; 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing plus 10 (3d6) Psychic.

actions.name: Agonizing Cackle (1/Day)
actions.description: Wisdom save DC 19, each creature in a 60-foot Cone: 45 (10d8) Psychic and Incapacitated until the start of the hag's next turn, half damage only on success.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: Charisma, save DC 19, no Material components. At will: Command (level 2), Hold Person, Minor Illusion, Stinking Cloud. 1/day each: Befuddlement, Dominate Person, Scrying, Word of Recall (lair as sanctuary).

bonusActions.name: Shape-Shift
bonusActions.description: Shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid or back, keeping its statistics except size; gear doesn't change.

monster:pumpkin-head.languages: understands Common and one other language but speaks only through Mimicry

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.description: Mimics the voice of the person it replaced or of anyone whose personality it consumed; a DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check reveals the imitation.

traits.name: Sorrowful Memento
traits.description: Disadvantage on D20 Tests while it can see a creature holding a possession of the person it replaced.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: One Claw and one Pitchfork attack, and Personality Consumption if available.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic.

actions.name: Pitchfork
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 10 ft.; 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing, and it can push or pull a Medium or smaller target 5 feet.

actions.name: Personality Consumption (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Intelligence save DC 12, one creature it can see within 30 feet: Stunned until the end of its next turn and Intelligence reduced by 1d4, dying at 0. A Humanoid slain this way is replaced by a new Pumpkin Head 1d8 hours later unless its body is burned.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.description: If damage other than Radiant or a Critical Hit reduces it to 0 Hit Points, it makes a Constitution save (DC 5 + the damage), dropping to 1 Hit Point instead on a success.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee attack, +4, reach 5 ft.; 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic.

actions.name: Harbinger of Doom (2/Day)
actions.description: Wisdom save DC 11, one creature within 60 feet: 5 (1d10) Psychic and Frightened until the end of its next turn, half damage only on success.

reactions.name: Death Veil
reactions.description: A creature within 30 feet making a Death Saving Throw has Advantage on it.

monster:reveler-of-song.senses: blindsight 10 ft. (Drone only), darkvision 60 ft.; passive Perception 14

traits.name: Compelled Contest
traits.description: It can't refuse a musical contest: a creature can make a Charisma (Performance) check with a Musical Instrument as an Influence action, and the reveler must succeed on a Charisma save against that total or take 20 Psychic and be Stunned until the end of the creature's next turn.

traits.name: Dancing Step
traits.description: Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it leaves an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Ensemble Form
traits.description: It takes the Drone (hurdy-gurdy), Drum (frame drum), or Bell (handbells) form, which sets some traits and actions.

traits.name: Droning Swarm (Drone Only)
traits.description: Bees surround it; a creature that ends its turn in its 10-foot Emanation makes a DC 16 Constitution save or is Poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Instrumental Blast attacks.

actions.name: Instrumental Blast
actions.description: Melee or ranged attack, +8, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft.; 14 (2d8 + 5) Thunder.

actions.name: Infectious Rhythm (Drum Only)
actions.description: Wisdom save DC 16, up to two creatures it can see within 30 feet: 18 (4d8) Psychic and affected by Irresistible Dance (no Concentration needed), half damage only on success.

actions.name: Stunning Clangor (Bell Only)
actions.description: Constitution save DC 16, one creature it can see within 60 feet: 40 (9d8) Thunder and Stunned until the end of the reveler's next turn, half damage only on success.

monster:reveler-of-stories.senses: darkvision 60 ft., truesight 120 ft. (Witch only); passive Perception 16

traits.name: Moral Quandary
traits.description: A creature can use a Bonus Action to recite a story's moral matching its form, weakening it for 1 hour: no Reactions and AC reduced by 4.

traits.name: Storied Form
traits.description: It takes the Great Beast, Hero, or Witch form (monsters, heroes, or wicked magicians), which sets some traits and Fabled Assault. In Hero form its AC is 17.

traits.name: Terror Feeding (Witch Only)
traits.description: If a Frightened creature is within 30 feet at the end of its turn, it gains 15 Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Three Thrash attacks; it can replace one with Fabled Assault if available.

actions.name: Thrash
actions.description: Melee attack, +9, reach 10 ft.; 18 (3d8 + 5) Force.

actions.name: Fabled Assault (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: By form: Consuming Bite (Great Beast; DC 17 Constitution save, one creature within 5 feet, Disadvantage if grappled by it: 36 (8d8) Necrotic, and a Huge or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 15) and Restrained while grappled, half damage only on success; it gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage); Heroic Charge (Hero; moves its Speed in a line through creatures without provoking Opportunity Attacks, each creature whose space it enters making a DC 17 Strength save: 26 (4d12) Force and Prone, half damage only on success); Wicked Storm (Witch; DC 17 Dexterity save, 60-foot Cone: 27 (6d8) Lightning and Frightened with Speed 0, repeating the save each turn end and succeeding automatically after 1 minute; half damage only on success).

reactions.name: Dramatic Reversal
reactions.description: When hit by an attack roll, it adds 4 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing a miss.

traits.name: Fungal Step
traits.description: Ignores Difficult Terrain caused by plants or fungi.

traits.name: Hunting Horn
traits.description: It carries a horn with AC 16, 10 Hit Points, and immunity to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic.

traits.name: Iron Binding
traits.description: With iron wrapped around part of its body (bracelet, Manacles, or Chain, treated as Manacles), it can only do two of move, action, and Bonus Action each turn.

actions.name: Staff
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 7 (1d8 + 3) Necrotic.

actions.name: Call the Rot (Requires Hunting Horn; Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Constitution save DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone: 11 (2d10) Necrotic and Poisoned until the end of its next turn, half damage only on success. The call carries 300 feet, and noncreature plants in the Cone rot and die.

monster:salmon-of-knowledge.speed: 5 ft., fly 30 ft. (hover; Orb of Water only), swim 30 ft.
monster:salmon-of-knowledge.languages: understands all languages but can't speak, telepathy 60 ft.

traits.name: Orb of Water
traits.description: A sphere of flowing water surrounds and moves with it, granting Fire Resistance while it is inside. A creature grappling it can pull it out; the orb then moves up to 20 feet toward it at the start of each of its turns, ending the grapple when it reaches the salmon.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.description: Can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Water Spray attacks; it can replace one with Prophetic Guidance.

actions.name: Water Spray
actions.description: Ranged attack, +5, range 20/60 ft.; 6 (1d6 + 3) Cold.

actions.name: Prophetic Guidance (2/Day)
actions.description: A creature it can see within 30 feet can, once in the next minute, add 1d4 to a failed D20 Test, possibly turning it into a success.

reactions.name: Echo from the Current
reactions.description: When a creature within 5 feet makes an Intelligence or Wisdom check, it can use the salmon's Wisdom modifier (+4) instead of its own.

monster:shrouded.damageResistances: Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Piercing, Slashing, Thunder
monster:shrouded.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained

traits.name: Mist Form
traits.description: Can enter and stop in another creature's space and move through a 1-inch gap at no extra cost.

traits.name: Corrupting Mist
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn in its space makes a DC 13 Constitution save, taking 10 (3d6) Necrotic or half on success. A Humanoid killed this way becomes a new shrouded at the start of the shrouded's next turn, acting on that Initiative, and can't be revived until the new one is destroyed.

traits.name: Graveyard Warding
traits.description: Can't pass a barrier or line of iron, such as a wrought-iron fence or iron filings; the barrier extends 1 mile up.

traits.name: Variation
traits.description: It is a Devourer, Reaper, or Whisperer, granting one unique action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two melee attacks.

actions.name: Corrupting Touch
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 6 (1d6 + 3) Necrotic.

actions.name: Consuming Bite (Devourer Only)
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 10 ft.; 5 (1d4 + 3) Bludgeoning, and a Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 13), taking 10 (3d6) Necrotic at the start of each of its turns while grappled, which the shrouded regains as Hit Points.

actions.name: Scythe (Reaper Only)
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic, and a creature can't regain Hit Points until the start of the shrouded's next turn.

actions.name: Toxic Thoughts (Whisperer Only)
actions.description: Intelligence save DC 13, each non-Construct, non-Undead creature in a 30-foot Emanation: 7 (2d6) Psychic and Frightened until the start of the shrouded's next turn, half damage only on success.

monster:soulfire-stoker.conditionImmunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Corpse Fuel
traits.description: If it sees a corpse at the start of its turn, it must move into the corpse's space and use its action to burn it; Medium or smaller corpses become ash, larger ones shrink one size.

traits.name: Fire Form
traits.description: Moves through a 1-inch gap at no extra cost and can enter and stop in a creature's space, dealing 4 (1d8) Fire the first time it enters a creature's space on a turn.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.description: Sheds Dim Light in a 30-foot radius.

traits.name: Soul Burn
traits.description: At the end of each of its turns, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation takes 4 (1d8) Necrotic.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Sear attacks.

actions.name: Sear
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 7 (1d8 + 3) Fire, and the target has Disadvantage on its next attack before the stoker's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Spectral Steam (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.description: Dexterity save DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone: on failure it sheds Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from being Invisible.

monster:squabswarm.languages: understands Common and Sylvan but can't speak
monster:squabswarm.conditionImmunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Compelled Delivery
traits.description: As an Influence action, a creature can hand it a letter or parcel for a recipient the creature knows; the swarm is Charmed until it delivers it or takes damage, and must deliver it if it knows where the recipient is.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: Can share another creature's space and move through openings large enough for a Tiny pigeon; it can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Unerring Delivery
traits.description: While delivering, it knows the distance and direction to the recipient on the same plane.

actions.name: Peck
actions.description: Melee attack, +4, reach 5 ft.; 5 (2d4) Piercing, or 2 (1d4) while Bloodied; while not Bloodied, a creature it hits is Charmed until the start of the swarm's next turn.

reactions.name: Many Eyes, One Voice (1/Day)
reactions.description: When a creature that gave it a delivery and is on the same plane uses an action to look through it, the swarm becomes a scrying sensor as if that creature cast Scrying, and the creature can speak through it.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
traits.description: If he fails a save, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

traits.description: Undead of his choice (not himself) in his 60-foot Emanation have Advantage on attacks and saves, unless he is Incapacitated.

traits.name: Name of Rest
traits.description: His AC is 10 against attacks with a weapon inscribed with the runes of his original name, and he has Disadvantage on attacks against a creature holding one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Three Soul Blade attacks; he can replace one with Life Drain.

actions.name: Soul Blade
actions.description: Melee or ranged attack, +14, reach 5 ft. or range 40/80 ft.; 17 (3d6 + 7) Slashing plus 13 (3d8) Necrotic, and a thrown blade returns to his hand.

actions.name: Life Drain

actions.name: Blade Storm (Recharge 5-6)

legendaryActions.name: Lord's Call
legendaryActions.description: Summons two obedient Wights within 30 feet that act right after him for 1 hour, until either dies, or until he uses this again; a creature starting its turn within 5 feet of one makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or is Frightened until the start of its next turn. traits.name: Blighted Overgrowth
traits.description: While Bloodied, it has Disadvantage on attacks, Spew Blight recharges at the start of its turn, and it regains 20 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1, unless it took Fire damage since its last turn.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If it fails a save, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Project Image
actions.description: Casts Project Image without components, using Wisdom, and can use Spew Blight and Rot Stride from the image's space while it lasts.

actions.name: Spew Blight (Recharge 5-6)

If the doll breaks, the soul rises as a Shadow under her control; the creature can be revived only after Wish frees the soul or the Shadow it spawned is destroyed.

If it takes 50 or more damage in one turn from inside, it makes a DC 25 Constitution save at the end of that turn or regurgitates everyone Prone within 10 feet; if it dies, they can escape using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone. Not again until the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Jinxed Hide
reactions.description: When a creature within 60 feet hits it with an attack or targets it with a spell, that creature makes a DC 20 Wisdom save or is cursed until the end of its next turn, with Disadvantage on D20 Tests and unable to regain Hit Points.

legendaryActions.name: Devour
legendaryActions.description: One Bite attack or Swallow. Not again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Swamp Surge
legendaryActions.description: Strength save DC 20, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation: 21 (6d6) Bludgeoning and Speed 0 until the end of its next turn, half damage only on success. Not again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Tail Sweep
legendaryActions.description: Moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and makes one Tail attack. (Legendary Action Uses: 3, or 4 in Lair.)

traits.name: Bitter Medicine
traits.description: A creature that uses a Bonus Action to belittle his humor and succeeds on a DC 16 Charisma (Deception) check gives him Disadvantage on attacks against anyone else until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Infinite Jest
traits.description: He creates an insubstantial illusory Small jester in his space that he can move up to 60 feet each turn unless Incapacitated, perceiving and speaking through it; it can manipulate objects as if it had Strength 10.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If he fails a save, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Reactive
traits.description: Can take one Reaction on every turn of combat.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two attacks using Ribbon or Joy Buzzer in any combination; with Project Image active, he can make melee Joy Buzzer attacks from the image.

actions.name: Ribbon
actions.description: Melee attack, +10, reach 15 ft.; 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing, and a Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 15) by one of six ribbons and Restrained while grappled.

actions.name: Joy Buzzer
actions.description: His jester moves to the target. Melee or ranged attack, +10, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft.; 24 (3d12 + 5) Lightning, and the target can't take Reactions until the end of his next turn. Hit or miss, the jester then returns to his space.

actions.name: Exploding Pie (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Dexterity save DC 18, each creature in a 20-foot Sphere on a point within 100 feet: 16 (3d10) Acid and Blinded until the end of his next turn, half damage only on success.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: Charisma, save DC 19, no Material components. At will: Hideous Laughter, Project Image (as a Small jester), Vicious Mockery (4d6 Psychic). 1/day each: Irresistible Dance, Magnificent Mansion.

bonusActions.name: Ribbon Step
bonusActions.description: Vanishes in confetti and teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 30 feet.

legendaryActions.name: Frolic
legendaryActions.description: Moves up to half his Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, passing through creatures at no extra cost; each creature whose space he enters takes 7 (2d6) Psychic once per turn.

legendaryActions.name: Joke's on You
legendaryActions.description: Uses Spellcasting to cast Irresistible Dance or Vicious Mockery.

legendaryActions.name: Ribbon Dance
legendaryActions.description: Strength save DC 18, each creature he grapples: 22 (4d10) Bludgeoning, half on success. Not again until the start of his next turn. (Legendary Action Uses: 3.)

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
traits.description: If he fails a save, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Memory's Dance
traits.description: A creature can use a Bonus Action to dance steps from his court and make a DC 20 Charisma (Performance) check; on a success he takes 20 Force and has Disadvantage on D20 Tests until the start of that creature's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Claw attacks, and he uses Spellcasting to cast Vicious Mockery (4d6 Psychic).

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee attack, +12, reach 15 ft.; 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing plus 14 (4d6) Psychic, and a Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 14) by one of two claws and Restrained while grappled.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: Charisma, save DC 19, no Material components. At will: Invisibility, Minor Illusion, Vicious Mockery (4d6 Psychic). 2/day: Darkness.

bonusActions.name: Elusive Disguise
bonusActions.description: Transforms into a Small or Medium Humanoid of any features, always unnaturally tall, or back, keeping his statistics except size; his gear adapts, and he reverts on death.

reactions.name: Evasive Blink
reactions.description: When he takes damage, he gains Resistance to it and teleports up to 30 feet to a space he can see.

legendaryActions.name: Spellcasting
legendaryActions.description: Uses Spellcasting.

legendaryActions.name: Strike
legendaryActions.description: One Claw attack. Not again until the start of his next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Teleport
legendaryActions.description: Teleports up to 60 feet to a space he can see; a creature he grapples makes a DC 18 Charisma save or comes along to the nearest open space. (Legendary Action Uses: 3, or 4 in Lair.)

monster:the-vermintoll-abomination.languages: Common, Deep Speech, Infernal, Primordial (Auran), Sylvan

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.description: If it fails a save, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.description: It has three heads (centipede hag, pigeon hag, weasel hag). Whenever it takes 50 or more damage in one turn, a random head dies; it dies when all are dead. At the end of each of its turns, if it has at least 1 Hit Point and a dead head, it regains 20 Hit Points and one dead head revives.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Three attacks using Cauldron Slam or Brew Spray in any combination.

actions.name: Cauldron Slam
actions.description: Melee attack, +9, reach 5 ft.; 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning plus 9 (2d8) Acid.

actions.name: Brew Spray
actions.description: Ranged attack, +7, range 90 ft.; 20 (4d8 + 2) Acid, and the target takes a -2 penalty to AC until the end of the abomination's next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: Charisma, save DC 18, no Material components. At will: Dispel Magic, Hypnotic Pattern. 1/day each: Contagion, Dominate Person, Dream.

legendaryActions.name: Corrosive Teleport
legendaryActions.description: Teleports up to 60 feet to a space it can see; each creature in a 10-foot Emanation at the destination makes a DC 18 Dexterity save, taking 7 (2d6) Acid or half on success.

legendaryActions.name: Crushing Leap
legendaryActions.description: Jumps to a space within 30 feet holding Large or smaller creatures; each there makes a DC 17 Dexterity save: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning and Prone, or half damage and pushed 5 feet away on success. Not again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Hag's Head
legendaryActions.description: One option from a living head, each not again until the start of its next turn: Contagious Miasma (centipede; DC 18 Constitution save, one creature within 5 feet: 13 (3d8) Poison and Poisoned, unable to heal while Poisoned, resaving after each Long Rest; half damage only on success); Overwhelming Doubt (pigeon; DC 18 Wisdom save, one creature within 30 feet: 10 (3d6) Psychic and Incapacitated until the end of its next turn, half damage only on success); Waking Nightmare (weasel; DC 18 Charisma save, one creature within 30 feet: 11 (2d10) Psychic and Frightened, seeing its allies as enemies though not compelled to act, repeating the save each turn end and succeeding automatically after 1 minute; half damage only on success). (Legendary Action Uses: 3.)

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If she fails a save, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Reopened Memories
traits.description: If at the start of her turn she sees a memento of her husband or another reminder of her loss, she has Disadvantage on D20 Tests and can spend only 2 Legendary Action uses until her next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Injection attacks.

actions.name: Injection
actions.description: Melee or ranged attack, +8, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft.; 1 Piercing plus 10 (3d6) Poison, and a creature is Poisoned until the end of its next turn with one effect of her choice (each once per turn): Hyperphobic Stimulant (Frightened, and at the start of its turn it makes a DC 16 Wisdom save or Dashes away from her by the safest route); Soporific Infusion (DC 16 Constitution save or Speed halved, only an action or a Bonus Action each turn, and one attack per Attack action, or Unconscious for 1 minute, until damaged, or until shaken awake on a failure by 5 or more); Thaumaturgic Inhibitor (when it casts a spell, it makes a DC 16 Constitution save or the spell fails without expending the slot).

legendaryActions.name: Alacrity
legendaryActions.description: She or a creature she is riding moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Dose
legendaryActions.description: One Injection attack. Not again until the start of her next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Hypertrophic Injections
legendaryActions.description: She or an ally within 5 feet gains one effect: Aggression (Advantage on attacks until the end of its next turn), Fortitude (ends one of Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Restrained, or Stunned), or Vigor (regains 10 Hit Points). Not again until the start of her next turn. (Legendary Action Uses: 3.)

monster:the-white-worm.senses: tremorsense 60 ft., truesight 60 ft.; passive Perception 14
monster:the-white-worm.languages: understands all languages but can't speak, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Inscrutable Mind
traits.description: A creature that tries to read its mind makes a DC 19 Intelligence save or is Stunned, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns and succeeding automatically after 1 minute.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.description: If it fails a save, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.description: If it uses Devour Mind on a creature that knows a special sequence of constellations and their path, at the start of that creature's next turn it takes 50 Psychic and Devour Mind ends.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.description: Burrows through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed, leaving a 10-foot-diameter tunnel.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: One Bite attack, and Psychic Caress on one or two creatures.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +15, reach 10 ft.; 25 (3d10 + 9) Piercing plus 7 (2d6) Force, and a Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 19).

actions.name: Psychic Caress
actions.description: Intelligence save DC 19, one creature it can see within 60 feet: 17 (5d6) Psychic and Frightened until the start of the worm's next turn, half damage only on success.

actions.name: Devour Mind (1/Day)
actions.description: It vanishes into the mind of a creature it can see within 60 feet (not one protected by Mind Blank or Protection from Evil and Good), taking no actions while the target watches it eat its memories and takes 88 (16d10) Psychic at the end of each of its turns. At 0 Hit Points the target is Stable but loses all memories permanently (only Wish restores them), and the worm reappears within 60 feet. It also ends if the target uses an action on a DC 20 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma check and the worm then fails a Charisma save against that total; if the target receives an effect that ends possession, such as Dispel Evil and Good; or when the target takes damage, the worm takes half as much Psychic and fails a Charisma save with DC equal to that damage.

legendaryActions.name: Slither
legendaryActions.description: Moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Spawn Parasites
legendaryActions.description: Constitution save DC 20, each creature in a 60-foot Cone: on failure it is infested and Poisoned, taking 7 (2d6) Necrotic plus 7 (2d6) Psychic at the start of each of its turns; a creature killed this way rises 24 hours later as a Wormhost Surgeon. Anything that ends the Poisoned condition, or 10 or more Poison damage dealt to the host, kills the worms. Not again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Strike
legendaryActions.description: One Bite attack. Not again until the start of its next turn. (Legendary Action Uses: 3, or 4 in Lair.)

monster:the-wicker-man.languages: understands all languages but can't speak
monster:the-wicker-man.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, incapacitated, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, stunned, unconscious

traits.name: Burning Aura
traits.description: At the end of each of its turns, each creature of its choice in a 15-foot Emanation takes 5 (1d10) Fire, and creatures and flammable objects there start burning.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.description: If it fails a save, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Reactive
traits.description: Can take a Reaction on every turn of combat.

traits.name: Soul Motes
traits.description: It has 3 Soul Motes, gaining 1 when a creature that isn't a Construct or Undead dies within 30 feet, and resetting to 3 after a Long Rest. It spends them on Soul Mote Reactions.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Blazing Slam attacks.

actions.name: Blazing Slam
actions.description: Melee attack, +11, reach 15 ft.; 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning plus 9 (2d8) Fire.

actions.name: Cremating Flame (Recharge 6)
actions.description: Dexterity save DC 18, each creature in a 60-foot Cone: 35 (10d6) Fire, half on success. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points becomes ash and its soul is absorbed; it can't be revived until the Wicker Man is destroyed.

reactions.name: Crushing Blow (Soul Mote)
reactions.description: When it hits with an attack, it spends 1 Soul Mote to make the hit a Critical Hit.

reactions.name: Repair (Soul Mote)
reactions.description: When it starts its turn, it spends 1 Soul Mote to regain 20 Hit Points.

legendaryActions.name: Burning Clutch
legendaryActions.description: Strength save DC 19, one creature within 15 feet: Grappled (escape DC 16) by one of two hands and Restrained while grappled, taking 10 (3d6) Fire at the start of the Wicker Man's turn. Not again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Slam
legendaryActions.description: One Blazing Slam attack. Not again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Stride
legendaryActions.description: Moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. (Legendary Action Uses: 3.)

monster:the-wild-titan.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft.; passive Perception 20

traits.name: Magic Resistance

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: Deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Massive Fist attacks; it can replace one or both with Thrown Boulder.
