actions.name: Thrown Boulder
actions.description: Dexterity save DC 25, each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere on a point within 150 feet: 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning and Prone, half damage only on success.

actions.name: Wild Roar (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Wisdom save DC 19, each enemy in a 100-foot Emanation: Charmed until the start of its next turn, using its action to make its strongest attacks against the nearest creature it can see.

legendaryActions.name: Arm Sweep
legendaryActions.description: Dexterity save DC 25, each creature in a 20-foot Cone: 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning and Prone, half damage only on success. Not again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Crushing Hurl
legendaryActions.description: Hurls a held object, a grappled creature, or a Large clod of earth to a space within 100 feet; each creature there, including a hurled one, makes a DC 25 Dexterity save: 19 (2d8 + 10) Bludgeoning and Prone, half damage only on success. Not again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Stomping Stride
legendaryActions.description: Moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, entering Huge or smaller creatures' spaces and pushing them to the nearest open space. (Legendary Action Uses: 3, or 4 in Lair.)

monster:vermin-familiar.senses: blindsight 30 ft. (Pigeon only), darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 30 ft. (Centipede only); passive Perception 15

traits.name: Disparate Incarnation
traits.description: It takes a Centipede, Pigeon, or Weasel body, which sets some traits and actions.

traits.name: Fear of Canines
traits.description: If it sees a dog, wolf, or other canine at the start of its turn, it is Frightened until its next turn, with Disadvantage on saves meanwhile.

traits.name: Spider Climb (Centipede Only)
traits.description: Can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.

traits.name: Vermin Telepathy

actions.name: Incarnated Assault (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: By incarnation, against one creature it can see within 5 feet, half damage only on success: Confounding Scratch (Weasel; DC 12 Charisma save, 21 (6d6) Necrotic and affected by Confusion until the start of its next turn); Infectious Sting (Centipede; DC 12 Constitution save, 10 (3d6) Poison and Poisoned and Paralyzed until the end of its next turn); Terrifying Flutter (Pigeon; DC 12 Wisdom save, 21 (6d6) Psychic and Frightened until the end of its next turn, fleeing by the safest route).

actions.name: Invisibility

At the start of each of the grappled creature's turns, roll 1d6: 1-2 Centipede Sting (4 (1d8) Poison and Poisoned until its next turn); 3-4 Pigeon Cry (10 (3d6) Psychic); 5-6 Weasel Drain (5 (1d10) Necrotic, reducing its Hit Point maximum by that much).

traits.name: Biting Gift
traits.description: If a creature willingly offers her one of its teeth, she must accept and is Charmed for 24 hours or until that creature or its allies damage her or force her to save.

traits.name: Coven Magic
traits.description: Within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, she can cast Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Lucky Charm (lasting until she casts it again or ends it), or Unseen Servant, each once per Long Rest, without Material components, using Intelligence.

actions.description: Wisdom save DC 13, one creature she can see within 30 feet (Disadvantage if she holds one of its teeth): 21 (6d6) Psychic and Frightened, seeing its allies as nightmare foes though not compelled to harm them, repeating the save each turn end and succeeding automatically after 1 minute; half damage only on success.

bonusActions.name: Shape-Shift
bonusActions.description: Becomes a Tiny weasel (Speed 30 ft., climb 30 ft.) or a Small or Medium Humanoid, or returns to her true form, keeping her statistics except size and weasel Speed; gear doesn't change.

actions.name: Infested Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Dexterity save DC 14, each creature in a 20-foot Cone: 17 (5d6) Psychic and infested with larval worms, taking 7 (2d6) Psychic at the end of each of its turns until it takes Poison damage or an effect ends the Poisoned condition on it; half damage only on success. A creature this damage kills dies, and a Humanoid slain this way rises 24 hours later as a wormhost surgeon.

reactions.name: Protective Parasite
reactions.description: When it drops to 0 Hit Points, the parasite in its brain spits acid: each creature in a 20-foot by 5-foot Line makes a DC 14 Dexterity save, taking 10 (3d6) Acid or half on success.

monster:serum-brute.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius unless Unleashed Eyes is active); passive Perception 15

traits.name: Curse Dependent
traits.description: If targeted by Remove Curse or similar magic, it loses its Blindsight, Withering Eye, and Cursed Gaze until it finishes a Long Rest.

traits.name: Stimulant Rush
traits.description: At the start of its turn it picks one, never the same twice in a row: Catalyst Infusion (until its next turn, Speed 50 feet, no Opportunity Attacks when leaving reach, long jump 30 feet and high jump 15 feet without a running start); Caustic Secretion (until its next turn, Fist deals an extra 11 (2d10) Acid); Stim Boost (10 Temporary Hit Points).

traits.name: Unleashed Eyes (1/Day)
traits.description: When it becomes Bloodied, its sealed eyes tear open: it is no longer blind beyond 60 feet and can use Withering Eye and Cursed Gaze until it finishes a Long Rest.

traits.name: Withering Eye (Unleashed Eyes Only)
traits.description: When it moves within 5 feet of a creature, that creature takes 4 (1d8) Psychic, once per turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Fist attacks, and Cursed Gaze if available.

actions.name: Fist
actions.description: Melee attack, +8, reach 10 ft.; 9 (1d8 + 5) Bludgeoning, plus 11 (2d10) Acid while Caustic Secretion is active.

actions.name: Cursed Gaze (Unleashed Eyes Only)
actions.description: Wisdom save DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot Cone: 9 (2d8) Psychic and Frightened until the start of its next turn, half damage only on success.

reactions.name: Devotion
reactions.description: When an ally within 5 feet takes damage, the ally gains Resistance to it and the brute takes Psychic damage equal to the damage the ally takes.

monster:skitterswarm.languages: understands Common and Sylvan but can't speak
monster:skitterswarm.conditionImmunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Body Burrowing
traits.description: If it sees a Humanoid corpse at the start of its turn, it must move toward it and, once there, stay for 1 hour, after which the flesh putrefies.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: Can share another creature's space and move through openings large enough for a Tiny centipede; it can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Vile Vermin
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn in its space makes a DC 12 Constitution save or contracts a magical contagion, unable to regain Hit Points and resaving after a Long Rest or when an effect ends the Poisoned condition on it; on success it is immune to all skitterswarms' contagion for 24 hours.

actions.name: Infesting Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +4, reach 5 ft.; 7 (2d6) Piercing, or 3 (1d6) while Bloodied, and a centipede infests a creature, dealing 3 (1d6) Necrotic at the start of each of its turns until it regains Hit Points or an effect ends the Poisoned condition on it.
